a: Vachachamim asu chizzuk ledivrehem yoter mishshel tora.

Tanu rabbanan: "ki chen tzuvveti", "kaasher tzivveti", "kaasher tzivva Adonai"; "ki chen tzuvveti" – baaninut yochluha, "kaasher tzivveti" – bishat maase amar lahen, "kaasher tzivva Adonai" – lo meelayy ani omer.
Ureminhi: mippene aninut nisrefa, lechach neemar: "kaelle"!
Amar shemuel: la kashya; ha rabbi yehuda, ha rabbi nechemya.

Detanya: mippene aninut serafuha, lechach neemar: "kaelle". divre rabbi nechemya. rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon omrim: mippene tumea nisrefa. sheim atta omer mippene aninut nisrefa – (hayu) [haya] lishloshtan sheyyissarfu. davar acher: (hayu) [haya] rauy leochlan laerev. davar acher: vahalo pinchas haya immahen!
Rava amar: idde veidde rabbi nechemya, vela kashya; kan bekodshe shaa, kan bekodshe dorot.
Rabbi nechemya hechi metaretz lehane kerae, verabbanan hechi metartzi lehu lehane kerae?

Rabbi nechemya metaretz lehu hachi: "maddua lo achaltem" – amar lo moshe leaharon: shemma nichnas damah lifnay velifnim? amar lo: "hen lo huva et damah". shemma chutz limchitzatah yatzat? amar lo: bakkodesh hayta.
Vedilma baaninut akrevtuha ufesaltuha? amar lo: moshe, vechi hem hikrivu?! ani hikravti! veamar lo: "hen lo huva et damah" uvakkodesh hayata – "achol tochlu otah kaasher tzivveti", baaninut yochluha.
Amar lo: "vattikrena oti kaelle veachalti chattat hayyom, hayyitav beene Adonai" – shemma lo shamata ella bekodshe shaa?
Dei bekodshe dorot, kal vechomer mimmaaser hakkal: uma maaser hakkal, amra tora: "lo achalti veoni mimmennu"; bekodshe dorot lo kol shekken?!
Miyyad "vayyishma moshe vayyitav beenav" – hoda velo bosh moshe lomar "lo shamati", ella amar: "shamati veshachachti".

Verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hechi metartzi lehu? hachi metartzi lehu: "maddua lo achaltem et hachattat bimkom [hakkodesh]" – shemma nichnas damah lifnay velifnim? amar lo: "hen lo huva et damah el hakkodesh penima".
Shemma chutz limchitzatah yatzat? amar lo: hen bakkodesh hayta. vedilma baaninut akrevtuha ufesaltuha? amar lo: moshe, hen hikrivuha – defasla behu aninut?! ani hikravtiha!
Vedilma aggav merarayychu peshatu ba veittammay? amar lo: moshe, kach ani beenecha, sheani mevazze kodshe shamayim?! "vattikrena oti kaelle"; vaafillu elle vechaelle – en ani mevazze kodshe shamayim!
Amar lo: vei "hen lo huva et damah", uvakkodesh hayta – "achol tochlu otah bakkodesh kaasher tzivveti", baaninut yochluha!
Amar lo: shemma lo shamata ella ballayla; dei bayyom – kal vachomer mimmaaser hakkal: uma maaser hakkal, amra tora: "lo achalti veoni mimmennu"; kodesh chamur – lo kol shekken?!
Miyyad "vayyishma moshe
b: Vayyitav beenav" – lo bosh moshe lomar "lo shamati", ella "shamati veshachachti".
Ibbei lehu leshahoyay, ulemechla beureta! tumea beones bata.
Bishlama lerabbanan, hayeynu dichtiv: "hayyom"; ella lerabbi nechemya, may "hayyom"? chovat hayyom.
Bishlama lerabbi nechemya, hayeynu dichtiv "hen hayyom"; ella lerabbanan, may "hen hayyom"? hachi kaamar: hen hikrivu?! ani hikravti!
Amar mar: (hayu) [haya] lishloshtan sheyyissarfu. may shelashtan?
Detanya: "veet seir hachattat darosh darash moshe"; "seir" – zo sair nachshon, "chattat" – zo chattat shemini, "darash" – sair shel rosh chodesh.

Yachol shelashtan nisrefu? talmud lomar: "vehinne soraf" – echad nisraf velo shelashtan nisrefu. "darosh darash" – shete derishot lamma? amar lehu: mippene ma chattat zo nisrefa, veellu munnachot? veeni yodea ezehu; keshehu omer: "veotah natan lachem laset et avon haeda", heve omer ze sair shel rosh chodesh.
Shappir kaamri leh! rabbi nechemya letameh, deamar: kodshe shaa la pasla behu aninut.
Amar mar: haya lo leochlah laerev. shappir kaamri leh! kasavar: aninut layla – deorayyta.

Davar acher: vahalo pinchas haya immahen. shappir kaamri leh! savar la kerabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: lo nitkahen pinchas ad sheharago lezimri, dichtiv: "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav berit kehunnat olam".
Rav ashe amar: ad shessam shalom ben hashshevatim, shenneemar: "vayyishma pinchas hakkohen unesie haeda verashe alfe yisrael vegomer".
Veiddach name, vehachtiv: "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav"! ki chetiv hahu, bivracha hu dichtiv.
Veiddach name, ha ketiv: "vayyishma pinchas hakkohen"! hahu leyaches zaro acharav.
Amar rav: moshe rabbenu – kohen gadol vecholek bekodshe shamayim haya, shenneemar: "meel hammilluim lemoshe haya lemana".
Metivi: vahalo pinchas haya immahen. veim ita, lema: vahalo moshe rabbenu haya immahen! dilma shane moshe, ditrid bishchina; deamar mar: moshe behashekama ala uvehashkama yarad.

Metivi: "lechem elohav mikkodshe hakkodashim umin hakkodashim yochel" – im neemru kodshe kadashim, lamma (neemar) [neemru] kadashim kallim? veim neemru kadashim kallim, lamma (neemar) [neemru] kodshe kadashim?

Illu lo (neemar) [neemru] kadashim kallim, hayiti omer: kodshe kadashim hu deochel, shehare hutteru lezar velahen; kadashim kallim – lo yochal. veillu lo neemru kodshe kadashim, hayiti omer: bekadashim kallim yehe ochel, shehen kallim; bekodshe kodashim – lo yehe ochel. lechach neemru kodshe kadashim, ulechach (neemar) [neemru] kadashim kallim.
Katane miha: shehare hutteru lezar velahen. lav moshe? amar rav sheshet: la; bevama lezar, uchedivre haomer: yesh mincha bevama.
Metivi: miryam mi hisgirah? im tomar moshe hisgirah – moshe zar hu,

a: Veen zar roe et hannegaim! veim tomar aharon hisgirah – aharon karov hu, veen karov roe et hannegaim! ella kavod gadol chalak lah hakkadosh baruch hu lemiryam otah shaa: ani kohen vaani masgirah, ani choltah vaani potrah.
Katane mihat: moshe zar, veen zar roe et hannegaim!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: shane marot negaim, deaharon uvanav ketuvin bapparasha.
Metivi: chamesh semachot hayta elisheva yetera al benot yisrael – yevamah melech, ishah kohen gadol, benah segan, ben benah meshuach milchama, veachiha nesi shevet; vaavela al shene baneha.
Katane mihat: yevamah melech – melech in, kohen gadol la! ema: af melech.
Ketannae: "vayyichar af Adonai bemoshe" – rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: kol charon af shebbattora neemar bo roshem, veze lo neemar bo roshem.
Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: af ze neemar bo roshem, shenneemar: "halo aharon achicha hallevi" – vahalo kohen hu! hachi kaamar: ani amarti atta kohen vehu levi, achshav hu kohen veatta levi.

Vachachamim omrim: lo nitkahen moshe, ella shivat yeme hammilluim bilvad. veyesh omrim: lo paska kehunna ella mizzaro shel moshe, shenneemar: "umoshe ish haelohim banav yikkaru al shevet hallevi", veomer: "moshe veaharon bechohanav ushemuel bekore shemo".
May veomer? vechi tema ledorot hu dichtiv, veomer: "moshe veaharon bechohanav".
Vechol charon af shebbattora neemar bo roshem?! vehachtiv: "vayyetze moshe meim paro bochori af", vela amar leh vela midde! amar resh lakish: setaro veyatza.
Umi amar resh lakish hachi?! vehachtiv: "venitztzavta likrato al sefat hayeor", veamar resh lakish: melech hu vehaseber lo panim, verabbi yochanan amar: rasha hu vehaez panecha bo! efoch.
Amar rabbi yannay: leolam tehe emat malchut alecha; dichtiv: "veyardu chol avadecha elle elay" – veillu ledideh la kaamar leh.
Rabbi yochanan amar mehacha: "veyad Adonai hayta el eliyyahu, vayshannes motnav vayyarotz lifne achav".
Amar ulla: bikkesh moshe malchut, velo natnu lo; dichtiv: "al tikrav halom", veen "halom" ella malchut – shenneemar: "mi anochi Adonai elohim [vegomer] ki haviotani ad halom".
Metiv rava, rabbi yishmael omer: yevamah melech! amar rava: lo ulezaro kaamar.
Vechol hecha dichtiv "halom" – ledorot hu?! veha gabbe shaul dichtiv: "hava od halom ish" – hu in, zaro la!
Ibbaet ema: ha hava ish boshet, veibbaet ema: shane shaul – daafillu begavveh la kaem;

Kidrabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: beshaa shepposkim gedulla laadam – poskim lo ulezaro ad sof kol haddorot, shenneemar: "lo yigra mitztzaddik enav veet melachim lakkisse vegomer". veim heges dato – hakkadosh baruch hu mashpilo, shenneemar: "veim asurim bazzikkim yillachdun bechavle oni".
Baale mumin, ben baale mumin kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "kol zachar" – lerabbot baale mumin.
Lemay? i laachila – hare kevar neemar: "lechem elohav mikkodshe hakkodashim yochel"! ella lachalukka.

Tanya iddach: "kol zachar" – lerabbot baale mumin. lemay? i laachila – hare kevar amur! i lachalukka – hare kevar amur! sheyyachol en li ella tam venaasa baal mum, baal mum meikkaro minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol zachar".

Tanya iddach: "kol zachar" – lerabbot baal mum. lemay? i laachila – hare kevar amur! vei lachalukka – hare kevar amur! vei levaal mum meikkaro – hare kevar amur! sheyyachol en li ella baal mum kavua, baal mum over minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol zachar".
Kelappe leyay? amar rav sheshet: efoch.
Rav ashe amar: leolam la tefoch; veitzterich, salka datach amena:
b: Ki tame; ma tame – kamma dela tahor la achel, af hay name – kamma dela mittekan la achel; ka mashma lan.
Kol sheeno rauy vechulei. vela?! vahare baal mum, delo rauy laavoda, vecholek! vetu, ha rauy laavoda cholek?! hare tame bekorbenot tzibbur, derauy laavoda, veeno cholek!
Rauy laachila kaamar.
Vahare katan, derauy laachila, veeno cholek! ha la katane.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, leolam (kidkaamar) [kidkaamrat] meikkara; i mishshum tame – tame la katane, vei mishshum baal mum – rachamana rabbeyeh.
Afillu tame bishat zerikat damim, vetahor bishat hekter chalavim – eno cholek. ha tahor bishat zerikat damim, vetame bishat hekter chalavim – cholek;

Matnitin dela keabba shaul. detanya, abba shaul omer: leolam eno ochel, ad sheyyehe tahor mishsheat zerika ad sheat hekter chalavim; deamar kera: "hammakriv et dam hashshelamim veet hachelev" – daafillu hekter chalavim name bae.
Bae rav ashe: nitma bentayim mahu? bishat zerika uvishat haketara baenan, vehaikka; o dilma ad sheyyehe tahor mishsheat zerika vead sheat hekter chalavim? teku.
Amar rava: hay dina – merabbi elazar berabbi shimon gemirna, deamar bevet hakkisse dantah – ba tevul yom veamar: ten li mimmincha veochal.
Amar lo: uma im bimkom sheyyippa kochacha – bechattatecha, dechitich mechattat yisrael; mekom shehora kochacha – beminchatecha, eno din sheedchacha mimminchat yisrael?!
Uma im dechitani mechattat yisrael – shekkeshem sheyyippa kochi kach yippa kochecha; tidcheni (mimmincha) [mimminchat yisrael], shekkeshem shehora kochi kach hora kochecha!
Hare hu omer: "lakkohen hammakriv otah lo tihye" – bo hakerev veechol.
Ten li mechattat yisrael veochal –
Amar lo: uma bimkom shehora kochi – beminchati, dechitich mimminchat yisrael; mekom sheyyippa kochi – bechattati, eno din sheedchacha mechattat yisrael?!
Amar lo: uma im sheddechitani mimminchat yisrael – shekkeshem shehora kochecha kach hora kochi; tidcheni mechattat yisrael – shekkeshem sheyyippa kochecha kach yippa kochi?!
Hare hu omer: "hakkohen hamechatte otah yochlenna" – bo chatte veechol.
Amar lo: ten li mechaze vashok veochal –
Amar lo: uma bimkom sheyyippa kochacha – bechattatecha, dechitich [mechattat yisrael] (mechaze vashok); mekom shehora kochacha – bishlamim, sheen lach bahen ella chaze vashok, eno din sheedchacha?!
Ma im dechitani mechattat – shekken hora kochi etzel nashayy vaavadayy; tidcheni mechaze vashok – shekken yippa kochi etzel nashayy vaavaday?!
Hare hu omer: "lakkohen hazzorek et dam hashshelamim lo yihye" – bo zerok veechol.
Yatza tevul yom kullav vachamurav al rosho, onen mimino, mechussar kappara missemolo.
Parech rav achay, lema leh: ten li mibbechor veochal!
Mishshum deamar leh: uma bimkom shehora kochi – bechattat, etzel nashayy vaavadayy, dechitich mechattat yisrael; mekom sheyyippa kochi – bivchor, dechulleh dili hi – eno din sheedchacha mimmennu?
Uma im dechitani mechattat – shekkeshem shehora kochacha kach hora kochi; tidcheni mibbechor – shekkeshem sheyyippa kochacha kach yippa kochi?!
Hare hu omer: "et damam tizrok al hammizbeach veet chelbam taktir... uvesaram yihye lecha" – bo zerok veechol.
Veiddach parech: mi ketiv "uvesaram lakkohen hazzorek"?! "uvesaram yihye lach" ketiv – afillu lechohen acher.
Vehechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bechol mekom muttar lehareher, chutz mimmerchatz umibbet hakkisse! leonso shane.

a: Mishna kol shello zacha hammizbeach bivsarah – lo zachu kohanim beorah; shenneemar: "olat ish" – ola shealta laish.
Ola shennishchata shello lishmah – af al pi shello alta labbealim, orah lakkohanim. echad olat haish veechad olat haishsha, orotehen lechohanim.

Orot kadashim kallim livalim, orot kodshe kadashim lechohanim. kal vachomer: uma im ola, shello zachu bivsarah – zachu beorah; kodshe kadashim, shezzachu bivsarah – eno din sheyyizku beorah?! en mizbeach yochiach – sheen lo or bechol makom.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "olat ish" – perat leolat hekdesh. divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: perat leolat gerim.
May perat leolat hekdesh? amar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef: perat leola havaa min hammotarot.
Hanicha leman deamar: motarot lenidvat tzibbur azli; ella leman deamar: motarot lenidvat yachid azli – may ikka lememar?
Kidamar rava: "haola" – ola rishona; hacha name, "haola" – ola rishona.
Rabbi ayyvu amar rabbi yannay: perat lematpis ola levedek habbayit.
La mibbaya leman deamar: kodshe bedek habbayit tafsi middeorayyta; ella afillu leman deamar la tafsi – hane mille basar, aval or tafes.
Vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: perat leola havaa min hammotarot.
Amar leh rav hamenuna lerav nachman: keman, kerabbi yehuda?! ha hadar beh! detanya: shishsha lindava – leola havaa min hammotarot, shello yehu kohanim zakkain beorah. divre rabbi yehuda.

Amar lo rabbi nechemya, veamri la rabbi shimon: im ken, bittalta midrasho shel yehoyada hakkohen! detanya, ze midrash darash yehoyada hakkohen: "asham hu ashom asham laAdonai" – kol shebba mishshum chattat umishshum asham, yillakach bo olot; habbasar lashshem, orah lakkohanim.
Amar leh: ella mar bemay mokem la? amar leh: mokemyna leh bemakdish nechasav.

Vechidrabbi yehoshua; ditnan: hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen behemot haruyot legabbe mizbeach, zecharim unekevot – rabbi eliezer omer: zecharim yimmachru letzorche olot, nekevot yimmachru letzorche zivche shelamim, udemehen yippelu im shear nechasim levedek habbayit.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: zecharim atzmam yikkarvu olot, unekevot yimmachru letzorche shelamim veyavi bidmehen olot, ushear nechasim yippelu levedek habbayit.
Vaafillu lerabbi yehoshua deamar adam cholek hekdesho – hane mille basar, aval or tafes.
Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: perat leolat gerim. amar leh rav simay bar chilkay leravina: attu ger lav ish hu?! amar leh: perat leger shemmet veen lo yorshim.
Tanu rabbanan: "olat ish" – en li ella olat ish; olat gerim nashim vaavadim minnayin? talmud lomar: "or haola" – ribba.
Veim ken, ma talmud lomar: "olat ish"? ola shealta leish; perat leshennishchata chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah, shello yehu hakkohanim zakkain beorah.
Yachol sheani merabbe shennishchata shello lishmah – hoil velo alta labbealim,
b: Lo yehu kohanim zakkain beorah? talmud lomar: "or haola" mikkol makom.

"Or haola" – en li ella or haola, orot kodshe kadashim minnayin? talmud lomar: "or haola asher hikriv". yachol sheani merabbe af kadashim kallim? talmud lomar "ola" – ma ola kodshe kadashim, af kol kodshe kadashim.

Rabbi yishmael omer: "or haola" – en li ella haola, orot kodshe kadashim minnayin? vedin hu: uma ola, shello zachu bivsarah – zachu beorah; kodshe kadashim, shezzachu bivsaran – eno din shezzachu beoran?!
Mizbeach yochiach – shezzacha bevasar velo zacha beor! ma lemizbeach – shekken lo zacha bemiktzat; tomar bakkohanim – shezzachu bemiktzat?! hoil vezachu bemiktzat, zachu bechulleh.
Rabbi omer: kol atzmo lo hutzerachnu ella leor haola bilvad. shebbechol makom haor mehallech achar habbasar.

Parim hannisrafin useirim hannisrafin – hen veorotehen nisrafin immahen. chattat veasham vezivche shalme tzibbur – mattana lakkohen; ratzu – mafshitin otan, lo ratzu – ochlin otan al gabbe oran. kadashim kallim – labbealim; ratzu – mafshitin otan, ratzu – ochlin otan al gav oran.
Aval ola neemar vah: "vehifshit et haola venittach otah lintacheha". yachol lo yehu hakkohanim zakkain beorah? talmud lomar: "or haola asher hikriv".

"Lo yihye" – perat litvul yom umechussar kippurim veonen. sheyyachol lo yizku bevasar – shehu laachila, yizku beor – sheeno laachila; talmud lomar: "lo yihye" – perat limchussar kippurim utevul yom veonen.
Vetanna kamma name tippok li middina! milleta deatya bekal vechomer, tarach vechatav la kera.
Verabbi yishmael, hay "asher hikriv" may aved leh? perat litvul yom umechussar kippurim veonen.

Vetippok leh milo yihye"! rabbi yishmael letameh, deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael: neemar beole "lo yihye", veneemar beasham "lo yihye"; ma lehallan atzmotav muttarin, af kan atzmotav muttarin.
Mufene; dei la mufene, ikka lemifrach: ma leasham shekken besaro muttar lo; "yihye" – kera yattira hu.

Mishna kol hakkodashim sheera bahen pesul kodem lehefshetan – en orotehen lakkohanim. leachar hefshetan – orotehen lechohanim. amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim: miyyamay lo raiti or sheyyotze levet hasserefa.
Amar rabbi akiva: middevarav lamadnu, shehammafshit et habbechor venimtza terefa – sheyyeotu hakkohanim beoro. vachachamim omrim: en "lo rainu" reaya, ella yetze levet hasserefa.

Gemara kol shello zacha hammizbeach bivsarah – lo zachu hakkohanim beorah, veaf al gav deappeshateh leor kodem zerika. manni? rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi, deamar: en haddam meratztze al haor bifne atzmo.

Ema sefa: kol hakkodashim sheera bahen pesul kodem hefshetan – en orotehen lechohanim. leachar hefshetan – orotehen lechohanim. atan lerabbi, deamar: "haddam meratztze al haor bifne atzmo". resha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon, sefa rabbi?!
Amar abbaye: middesefa rabbi hi, resha name rabbi hi; umode rabbi sheen hefshet kodem zerika.
Rava amar: midderesha rabbi elazar berabbi shimon, sefa name rabbi elazar berabbi shimon; may kodem hefshet

a: Umay acher hefshet – kodem shenniru lehefshet, achar shenniru lehefshet.
May rabbi umay rabbi elazar berabbi shimon? detanya, rabbi omer: haddam meratztze al haor bifne atzmo. ucheshehu im habbasar, nolad bo pesul ben kodem zerika ben leachar zerika – hare hu keyotze bo.

Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: en haddam meratztze al haor bifne atzmo. ucheshehu im habbasar – nolad bo pesul kodem zerika, hare hu keyotze bo. achar zerika, huretza basar shaa achat; yafshitennu, veoro lakkohanim.
Lema bidrabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua kamippalgi? "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam" – rabbi yehoshua omer: im en dam en basar, im en basar en dam.

Rabbi eliezer omer: dam – af al pi sheen basar, shenneemar: "vedam zevachecha yishshafech". im ken, ma talmud lomar: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam"? lomar lecha: ma dam bizrika, af basar bizrika. ha lamadta sherevach yesh ben kevesh lammizbeach.
Lema man deamar huretza – kerabbi eliezer, uman deamar lo huretza – kerabbi yehoshua?
Allibba derabbi eliezer – kulle alma la peligi; ki peligi allibba derabbi yehoshua.

Man deamar lo huretza – kerabbi yehoshua. man deamar huretza amar lach: ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam – ella bevasar, delekka peseda lakkohanim; aval or, deikka peseda lakkohanim – afillu rabbi yehoshua mode.
Mide dehave addiavad; ditnan: nitma basar o nifsal, o sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim – rabbi eliezer omer yizrok, rabbi yehoshua omer lo yizrok. umode rabbi yehoshua sheim zarak – huretza.
Amar rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim kulei. velo?! hare parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim!
Lemitzvatan la kaamrinan.
Hare kodem hefshet vekodem zerika! chalutz kaamrinan.
Vehaikka achar hefshet vekodem zerika lerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, deamar: en haddam meratztze al haor bifne atzmo!
Rabbi chanina kerabbi sevira leh. veibbaet ema: afillu tokma kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon – mode rabbi sheen hefshet kodem zerika.
Vehaikka nimtzet terefa bivne meayim!
Kasavar: nimtzet terefa bivne meayim – meratztze. dayka name – dekatane, amar rabbi akiva: middevarav lamadnu, shehammafshit et habbechor venimtza terefa – sheyyeotu hakkohanim beoro! shema minna.
Veella may ka mashma lan rabbi akiva? ha ka mashma lan: afillu bigvulin.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi akiva. veaf rabbi akiva lo amar ella keshehittiro mumeche, aval lo hittiro mumeche – lo.
Vehilcheta kedivre chachamim; basar bikvura, vehaor bisrefa.

Mishna parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim, bizman shehen nisrafin kemitzvatan – nisrafim bevet haddeshen umetammein begadim, veim enan nisrafin kemitzvatan – nisrafin bevet habbira veenan metammein begadim.
b: Hayu sovlin oto bemotot. yatzu harishonim chutz lechomat haazara vehaacharonim lo yatzu – harishonim metammein begadim, vehaacharonim enan metammein begadim ad sheyyatzu. yatzu ellu vaellu – metammein begadim. rabbi shimon omer: enan metammein ad sheyyutztzat haur berubban. nittach habbasar – en hassoref metamme begadim.

Gemara may bira? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: makom yesh behar habbayit, uvira" shemo. veresh lakish amar: kol habbayit kullo karuy "bira", shenneemar: "(veel) habbira asher hachinoti".

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu, shelosha bet haddeshanin hen: bet haddeshen gadol haya baazara – sheshsham sorfin pesule kodshe kadashim, veemure kadashim kallim, ufarim hannisrafin, useirim hannisrafin sheera bahen pesul kodem zerika.
Uvet haddeshen acher haya behar habbayit – sheshsham sorfin parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim sheera bahen pesul achar zerika. uchemitzvatan, chutz leshalosh machanot.

Tane levi: shelosha bet haddeshanin hen: bet haddeshen gadol haya baazara – sheshsham sorfin pesule kodshe kadashim, veemure kadashim kallim, ufarim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim sheera bahen pesul, ben kodem zerika ben leachar zerika. uvet haddeshen acher haya behar habbayit, sheshsham sorfin parim hannisrafin useirim hannisrafin sheera bahen pesul bitziatan. uchemitzvatan, chutz leshalosh machanot.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: lina mahu shettoil befarim hannisrafim uvisirim hannisrafim? mi amrinan: ki mahneya lina – bevasar devar achila, aval hane delav bene achila ninhu – la; o dilma la shena?
Amar rava: ha milleta ibbaya leh leabbaye, ufeshatna leh meha: veshavin sheim chishshev baachilat parim uvisrefatan – shello asa kelum. may, lav middemachshava la pasla – lina name la pasla?
Vedilma machshava hu dela pasla, aval lina pasla!
Ta shema: parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafin – moalin bahen mishshehukedshu. nishchatu – hucheshru lippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. may, lav linat basar?
La, linat emurin.
Veha middekatane sefa: kullan moalin bahen bevet haddeshen ad sheyyuttach habbasar – middesefa basar, resha name basar! midde irya?! sefa basar, resha emurin!
Ta shema, detane levi: sheera bahen pesul bitziatan. may, lav lina? la, pesul tumea ufesul yetzia.
Bae rabbi elazar: yetzia, mahu shettoil befarim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim?
May kamibbaya leh? amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: allibba deman deamar adayin lo higgia zemanno latzet.
Mi amrinan: hane mille basar – deen sofo latzet chova, aval hane desofan latzet chova – la; o dilma, hacha name lo higgia zemanno latzet?
Ta shema, detane levi: sheera bo pesul bitziato. may, lav pasul yetzia? la; pesul tumea ufesul lina.

Bae rabbi elazar: parim hannisrafim useirim hannisrafim, sheyyatza (rubbo) [rubban] bemiut ever – mahu? hach miuta deever batar rubba shadenan leh – veha la nafka leh; o dilma, batar rubba divhema shadenan?
Peshita dela shavkinan rubba divhema veazlinan batar rubba deevarim! ella sheyyatza chetzyo berov ever – hay miuta deever

a: Batar rov ever shadenan leh, veha nefak leh; o dilma batar behema shadenan leh? teku.
Rabba bar rav huna matne la begavre, bemitassekin bo chamishsha bene adam, unefaku telata ufashu lehu tere – may? batar rov mitassekin azlinan, o vatar behema azlinan? teku.
Bae rabbi elazar: parim useirim hannisrafim sheyyatzu vechazru, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan denafki lehu – ittammo lehu; o dilma, kevan dahadur hadur?

Amar rabbi abba bar memel, ta shema: hayu sovlin otan bemotot, harishonim yatzu chutz lechomat haazara vehaacharonim lo yatzu – harishonim sheyyatzu chutz lechomat haazara metammein begadim, vehaacharonim en metammein begadim ad sheyyatzu. vei salka datach kevan denafki lehu ittammo – hanach deikka gavvay (littame) [littammo]!
Amar ravina: vetisbera?! ha baena "veachar yavo el hammachane", velekka!
Ella rabbi elazar hechi bae la? kegon dinkiti la bevakulese.

Tanu rabbanan: parim ufara vesair hammishtalleach – hameshalleach, hassorfan vehammotzian metamme begadim; vehen atzman en metammein begadim, aval metammein ovchalin umashkin. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: para ufarim metammein ovchalin umashkin, sair hammishtalleach eno metamme. shehu chay, vehachay eno metamme ovchalin umashkin.
Bishlama lerabbi meir – kidtana deve rabbi yishmael; detana deve rabbi yishmael: "al kol zera zerua" –

Ma zeraim – sheen sofan leytamme tumea chamura, utzerichin hechsher; af kol sheen sofan leytamme tumea chamura, tzerichin hechsher. yatzta nivlat of tahor – shessofah leytamme tumea chamura, veen tzericha hechsher.
Ella lerabbanan – i it lehu detana deve rabbi yishmael, afillu sair hammishtalleach! i let leh, afillu para ufarim menalan?
Ki ata rav dimi amar, amri bemareva: tzerichin hechsher tumea mimmakom acher.
Bae rabbi elazar: parim useirim hannisrafim, mahu sheyyetammeu ovchalin umashkin bifnim kevachutz? mechussar yetzia kimchussar maase dame, o la?
Batar devaya hadar pashta: mechussar yetzia kimchussar maase dame.
Bea minneh rabbi abba bar shemuel merabbi chiyyay bar abba: nivlat of tahor, lerabbi meir, mahu shettetamme bichzayit?
Demachata leara – la tibbee lach; denaket befummeh – la tibbee lach; ki tibbee lach – denaket leh bideh: mechussar keriva kimchussar maase dame, o la?
Batar devaya hadar pashta:
b: Mechussar keriva lav kimchussar maase dame.
Etiveh: shelosha asar devarim neemru benivlat of tahor, veze echad mehen: tzericha machshava, veen tzericha hechsher, umetamme tumeat ovchalin bichvetza. may, lav rabbi meir hi?
La, rabbanan hi.
Veha katane resha: tzericha machshava veen tzericha hechsher; uman shamat leh hay sevara – rabbi meir; umidderesha rabbi meir, sefa name rabbi meir!
Midde irya?! ha kidita veha kidita.
Veha middekatane sefa: shechitatah umelikatah metaheret terefatah mittumeatah; man shamat leh hay sevara – rabbi meir; resha vesefa rabbi meir, umetziata rabbanan?!
In; resha vesefa rabbi meir, umetziata rabbanan.
Amar leh rav hamenuna lerabbi zera: la tittev akkarach ad deamrat li ha milleta: nivlat of tahor – lerabbi meir, monin lah rishon vesheni, o en monin rishon vesheni?
Amar leh: kol hecha dimtamme adam bemagga – monin bo rishon vesheni, kol hecha deen metamme adam bemagga – en monin bo rishon vesheni.
Bea minneh rabbi zera merabbi amme bar chiyyay, veamri la merabbi avin bar kahana, ha ditnan: chibbure ochlin al yede mashkin – chibbur letumea kalla, veen chibbur letumea chamura;
Monin bo rishon vesheni, o en monin bo rishon vesheni?
Amar leh: kol hecha dimtamme adam – monin bo rishon vesheni, en metamme adam – en monin bo rishon vesheni.
Yatzu ellu vaellu. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: lehallan hu omer – chutz leshalosh machanot, kan – lemachane achat; lomar lach: kevan sheyyatza chutz lemachane achat – metamme begadim.
Vehi gufa menalan? detanu rabbanan: "vehotzi et kol happar el michutz lammachane" – chutz leshalosh machanot. atta omer chutz leshalosh machanot; o eno ella machane achat?
Keshehu omer befar haeda: "michutz lammachane" – sheen tzarich lomar, shehare kevar neemar: "kaasher saraf et happar harishon"; litten lo machane sheniyya.
Keshehu omer "michutz lammachane" baddeshen – sheen tzarich lomar, shehare kevar neemar: "al shefech haddeshen yissaref"; litten lo machane shelishit.

Verabbi shimon – hay "michutz lemachane" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya, rabbi eliezer omer: neemar kan "chutz lammachane", veneemar lehallan "chutz lammachane"; ma lehallan – chutz leshalosh machanot, af kan – chutz leshalosh machanot. uma lehallan – lemizrachah shel yerushalayim,

a: Af kan – lemizrachah shel yerushalayim.
Ella lerabbanan hecha saref lehu? kidtanya: hechan nisrafin? litzfon yerushalayim, chutz leshalosh machanot. rabbi yose haggelili omer: abbet haddeshen nisrafin.

Amar rava: man tanna diflig aleh derabbi yose haggelili? rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi, detanya: "al shefech haddeshen yissaref" – sheyyehe sham deshen (sheyyakdim lesham deshen). rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: sheyyehe mekomo meshuppach.
Amar leh abbaye: dilma bimkomo meshuppach peligi.
Tanu rabbanan: hassoref metamme begadim, velo hammatztzit et haur metamme begadim, velo hamesadder et hammaaracha metamme begadim. veezehu hassoref? hamesayyea bishat serefa.

Yachol af mishshennaasu efer metamme begadim? talmud lomar: "otam" – otam metammein begadim, umishshennaasin efer en metammein begadim. rabbi shimon omer: otam metammein begadim, nittach habbasar en metammein begadim.
May benayyhu? amar rava: ikka benayyhu deshavveyeh charocha.
Hadaran alach tevul yom
Mishna hashshochet vehammaale bachutz – chayyayv al hashshechita, vechayyayv al haalaa.

Rabbi yose haggelili omer: shachat bifnim veheela bachutz. shachat bachutz veheela bachutz – patur, shello heela ella davar pasul. amru lo: af hashshochet bifnim umaale bachutz, kevan shehotzio – pesalo.

Hattame sheachal ben kodesh tame ben kodesh tahor – chayyayv. rabbi yose haggelili omer: tame sheachal tahor – chayyayv, vetame sheachal tame – patur, shello achal ella davar tame. amru lo: af tame sheachal et hattahor, kevan shennaga bo – timmeohu.
Vetahor sheachal tame – patur, sheeno chayyayv ella al tumeat hagguf.

Gemara bishlama heela – ketiv onesh uchetiv azhara. onesh – dichtiv: "veel petach ohel moed lo hevio". azhara – dichtiv: "hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha"; vechi ha deamar rabbi avin amar rabbi elazar: kol makom shenneemar "hishshamer", "pen" veal" – eno ella lo taase.
Ella shechita – bishlama onesh, dichtiv: "veel petach ohel moed lo hevio"; ella azhara menalan? amar kera: "velo yizbechu od".

Hay mibbee leh lechidrabbi elazar! deamar: minnayin lazzoveach behema lemarkulis shehu chayyayv? dichtiv: "velo yizbechu od et zivchehem" – im eno inyan lichdarkah, dichtiv: "echa yaavdu"; tenehu inyan leshello kedarkah.
Amar rabba: keri beh "velo yizbechu", ukeri beh "velo od".
Akkatti mibbee leh lechidtanya: ad kan hu medabber bekadashim shehikdishan bishat issur habbamot vehikrivan bishat issur habbamot –
b: Shehare onshan amur: "veel petach ohel moed", azhara – dichtiv: "hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha".
Mikkan veelach – bizvachim shehikdishan bishat hetter habbamot vehikrivan bishat issur habbamot,

Shenneemar: "lemaan asher yaviu bene yisrael et zivchehem asher hem zovchim" – zevachim shehittarti lecha kevar. "al pene hassade" – lomar lach: hazzoveach bishat issur habbamot, maale alav hakkatuv keillu hikriv al pene hassade.
"Vehevium laAdonai" – zo mitzvat ase. lo taase minnayin? talmud lomar: "velo yizbechu od".
Yachol yehe anush karet? talmud lomar: "chukkat olam tihye zot lahem ledorotam" – zot lahem velo acheret lahem.
Ella amar rabbi avin: kal vachomer; uma bimkom shello anash – hizhir, mekom sheanash – eno din shehizhir?!
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: im ken, lo yeamer lav bechelev – vetete kal vachomer minnevela: ma nevela shello anash – hizhir, chelev sheanash – eno din shehizhir?!
Ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: minnevela name la atya, deikka lemifrach: ma linvela shekken metamme!
Mishsheratzim temein. ma lishratzim temein – shemmetammein bemashshehu!
Mishsheratzim tehorim. ma lishratzim tehorim – sheissuran bemashshehu!
Meorla vechile hakkerem. ma leorla vechile hakkerem – shekken asurin bahanaa!
Mishsheviit. ma lishviit, shekken tofeset dameha!
Mitteruma – shekken lo huttar mikkelalah! mikkullehu name – shekken lo hutteru mikkelalan!
Amar rava: i kashya li ha kashya li – ha ditnan: pesach umila mitzvat ase,
Tete bekal vachomer mimmotir: ma motir shello anash – hizhir, pesach umila sheanash – eno din shehizhir?!
Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmata kammeh derav kahana, veamar li: mimmotir la atya, deikka lemifrach: ma lemotir – shekken en lo takkana, tomar pesach – yesh lo takkana.
Vechi mazhirin min haddin?! afillu leman deamar onshin min haddin, en mazhirin min haddin!
Ella kidrabbi yochanan, deamar: atya havaa–havaa;
Ma lehallan lo anash ella im ken hizhir, af kan lo anash ella im ken hizhir.

a: Rava amar: kidrabbi yona, deamar rabbi yona: atya "sham"–"sham"; ma lehallan lo anash ella im ken hizhir, af kan lo anash ella im ken hizhir.
Ashkechan muketre penim sheheelan lachutz; muketre chutz sheheelan lachutz minnayin?
Amar rav kahana, amar kera: "vaalehem tomar" – al hassemuchin tomar.
Matkef la rava: mi ketiv "vaalehem"?! "vaalehem" ketiv! ella kidtana deve rabbi yishmael: "vaalehem tomar" – learev parashiyyot.
Rabbi yochanan amar: atya havaa–havaa; ma lehallan muketre chutz, af kan muketre chutz.
Matkef la rav bivi, ha ditnan: sheloshim veshesh karetot betora – telatin veshav havyayn, deikka hammaale vehammaale! kashya.
Vehaditnan: hazzorek miktzat damim bachutz – chayyayv, menalan? nafka leh middetanya: "dam yechashev" – lerabbot hazzorek. divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: "o zavach" – lerabbot et hazzorek.
Verabbi yishmael, hay "o zavach" may aved leh? lechallek.
Verabbi akiva, lechallek mena leh? nafka leh millo yeviennu".
Verabbi yishmael – hahu mibbee leh: al hashshalem hu chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al hechaser. verabbi akiva – nafka leh millaasot oto".

Verabbi yishmael – chad lemuketre penim shechasru veheelan bachutz, vechad lemuketre chutz shechasru (veheelu) [veheelan] bachutz. veha tanya, rabbi yishmael omer: yachol muketre panim shechasru (veheelu) [veheelan] bachutz chayyayv? talmud lomar: "laasot oto" – al hashshalem chayyayv veeno chayyayv al hechaser.
Verabbi akiva – muketre penim shechasru (veheelu) [veheelan] bachutz, chayyayv.
Verabbi akiva, hay "dam yechashev" may aved leh? lerabbot shechitat haof. verabbi yishmael – nafka leh meo asher yishchat".
Verabbi akiva amar lach, hahu mibbee leh: al hashshochet hu chayyayv, velo al hammolek. verabbi yishmael – nafka leh mizze haddavar".
Detanya: "asher yishchat" – en li ella shochet behema; shachat of mena lan? talmud lomar: "o asher yishchat".
Yachol af hammolek? vedin hu: ma shechita deen derech hechsherah bifnim, chayyayv, melika shedderech hechsherah befanim, eno din shehu chayyayv? talmud lomar "ze haddavar".
Verabbi akiva amar lach: hahu mibbee leh ligzera shava.
Veha ditnan: hakkometz vehamekabbel damim bachutz patur – menalan? umehecha tete dechayyayv?
Tete mishshechita – ma lishchita, shekken nifselet shello leochlin befesach!
Tete mizzerika – ma lizrika, shekken zar chayyayv aleha mita!
b: Tete mibbenayyay.
Im ken, lo yeamer bizrika, vetete mibbenayyay!
Vetete mishshechita – ma lishchita, shekken nifselet shello leshem ochlin bappesach; tete mehaalaa – ma lehaalaa, shekken yeshnah bammincha; vetete mibbenayyay;
Lehachi ketiv kera, lememar dela ata mibbenayyay.
Amar rabbi avahu: shachat vezarak – ledivre rabbi yishmael chayyayv achat, ledivre rabbi akiva chayyayv shetayim.
Abbaye amar: afillu [ledivre] rabbi akiva eno chayyayv ella achat, deamar kera: "sham taase" – hakkatuv asaan lechullan avoda achat.
Zarak veheela – ledivre rabbi yishmael chayyayv shetayim, ledivre rabbi akiva eno chayyayv ella achat.
Abbaye amar: afillu [ledivre] rabbi akiva chayyayv shetayim; lehachi palginhu kera: "sham taale" vesham taase".
Shachat vezarak veheela – ledivre hakkol chayyayv shetayim.
Tanu rabbanan: "bammachane" – yachol hashshochet ola baddarom yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "el michutz lammachane".
Yachol chutz leshalosh machanot? (talmud lomar "o ez bammachane".) minnayin af bemachane leviyyay? talmud lomar: "bammachane".
I bammachane, yachol hashshochet ola baddarom yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "o el michutz lammachane".
Ma chutz lammachane meyuchad – sheen rauy lishchitat kadashim velishchitat kol zevach; yatza darom – sheaf al pi sheen rauy lishchitat kodshe kadashim, rauy lishchitat kadashim kallim.

Amar ulla: hashshochet al gaggo shel hechol – chayyayv, hoil veen rauy lishchitat kol zevach. matkef la rava: im ken, nichtov kera "(el) michutz lammachane", vela bae "el petach ohel moed"; "el petach ohel moed" lema li? lav lemaote gaggo?
Ulerava – im ken nichtov: "el petach ohel moed"; "bammachane" "(veel) michutz lammachane" lema li? lav leetoye gaggo?
Amar rav mari: leetoye kullah bifnim vetzavvarah bachutz.
[Tzavvarah] bachutz – peshita! ammay kafed rachamana – ashshechita; ushechita bachutz hi! ella leetoye kullah bachutz vetzavvarah bifnim.
Ittemar: hammaale bizman hazze – rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, resh lakish amar: patur.
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv – kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo. resh lakish amar patur – kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah velo kiddesha leatid lavo.

Nema deviflugeta derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua kamippalgi? ditnan, amar rabbi eliezer: keshehayu bonin bahechol – hayu osim kelaim bahechol, kelaim baazarot; ella shebbahechol bonin mibbachutz, uvaazara bonin mibbifnim.

Amar rabbi yehoshua: shamati shehayu makrivin af al pi sheen bayit, veochlim kodshe kadashim af al pi sheen kelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni af al pi sheen choma; mippene shekkedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo.
Lav mikkelal derabbi eliezer savar lo kiddesha?

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: mimmay? dilma dechulle alma – kedushsha rishona kiddesha lishatah vekiddesha leatid lavo; umar may dishmia leh kaamar, umar may dishmia leh kaamar! vechi tema: kelaim lerabbi eliezer lema li? litzniuta bealma.
Ittemar: hammaale veen bo kezayit, veetzem mashlimo lichzayit – rabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv, resh lakish amar: patur.
Rabbi yochanan amar chayyayv – chibbure olin keolin dame. resh lakish amar patur – chibbure olin lav keolin damu.
Bae rava: hammaale

a: Rosh ben yona sheen bo kezayit, umelach mashlimo lichzayit; mahu?
Amar leh rava mipparzikya lerav ashe: lav hayeynu pelugetayyhu derabbi yochanan veresh lakish? tibbee lerabbi yochanan, vetibbee leresh lakish;

Tibbee lerabbi yochanan – ad kan la kaamar rabbi yochanan hatam, ella etzem – demina devasar hu; aval melach, delav mina devar yona hu – la. tibbee leresh lakish – ad kan la kaamar resh lakish hatam, ella dei paresh minne lav mitzva leassoke; aval hacha, dei paresh mitzva leassoke – la. o dilma la shena?
Teku.
Rabbi yose haggelili omer kulei.
Heshiv rabbi tachat rabbi yose haggelili: ma leshochet bifnim umaale bachutz – shehayta lo sheat hakkosher; tomar beshochet chutz umaale bachutz – shello hayta lo sheat hakkosher?!
Heshiv rabbi elazar berabbi shimon tachat rabbi yose haggelili: ma leshochet bifnim umaale bachutz – shekken kodesh mekabbelo; tomar beshochet bachutz – sheen kodesh mekabbelo?!
May benayyhu? amar zeeri: shechitat layla ikka benayyhu.
Rabba amar: kabbala bichli chol ikka benayyhu.
Tame sheachal ben kodesh kulei.
Shappir kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi yose haggelili!
Amar rava: kol hecha denitma tumeat hagguf veachar kach nitma basar – dechulle alma la peligi dechayyayv, shekken tumeat hagguf becharet.
Ki peligi – keshennitma basar veachar kach nitma hagguf.
Derabbanan savri amrinan miggo, verabbi yose haggelili savar la amrinan miggo.
Verabbi yose – nehi demiggo la amrinan; tete tumeat hagguf dachamira, vetachul al tumeat basar!
Amar rav ashe: mimmay detumeat hagguf chamura? dilma tumeat basar chamura, shekken en lah tohora bammikve!
Mishna chomer bashshechita mibbaaliyyay, uvaaliyyay mibbashshechita.
Chomer bashshechita – shehashshochet lahedyot chayyayv, vehammaale lahedyot patur. chomer baaliyyay – shenayim sheachazu besakkin veshachatu, peturim; achazu beever veheelu, chayyayvin.
Heela chazar veheela vechazar veheela – chayyayv al kol aliyyay. divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yose omer: eno chayyayv ella achat.
Veeno chayyayv ad sheyyaale lerosh hammizbeach. rabbi shimon omer: afillu heela al hassela o al haeven – chayyayv.
Gemara may shena hammaale lehedyot defatur – dichtiv "laAdonai", bashshechita name hachtiv "laAdonai"!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "ish ish". gabbe haalaa name ketiv: "ish ish"! mibbee leh lishnayim sheheelu beever – chayyayvin.
I hachi, hacha name mibbee leh lishnayim sheachazu besakkin veshachatu – shechayyayvin! shane hatam, deamar kera: "hahu" – echad velo shenayim.
I hachi, gabbe haalaa name – ha ketiv "hahu"!
b: Mibbee leh lemaote shogeg, anus umutee. i hachi, hacha name mibbee lemaote anus, shogeg umutee!
Tere "hahu" ketivi.
Veella "laAdonai" lema li? lehotzi sair hammishtalleach.
Chomer behaalaa kulei.

Tanu rabbanan: "ish ish" – ma talmud lomar? shenayim sheachazu beever veheelu, shechayyayvin. sheyyachol vahalo din hu: uma hashshochet lehedyot, shechayyayv – shenayim sheachazu besakkin veshachatu, peturin; hammaale lehedyot, sheppatur – eno din sheshshenayim sheachazu, peturin? talmud lomar: "ish ish". divre rabbi shimon.
Rabbi yose omer: "hahu" – echad velo shenayim. im ken, ma talmud lomar: "ish ish"? dibbera tora kilshon bene adam.
Verabbi shimon – hay "hahu" mibbee leh lemaote shogeg, anus, mutee. verabbi yose – mehu"–"hahu". verabbi shimon – "hu"–"hahu" la daresh.

Verabbi yose – middehay "ish ish" dibbera tora chilshon bene adam, hahu "ish ish" name dibbera tora chilshon bene adam. veella hashshochet lehedyot mena leh dechayyayv? nafka leh middam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach" – vaafillu hashshochet laish.
Heela vechazar veheela kulei.

Amar resh lakish: machloket bearbaa vachamishsha evarim; demar savar: ki ketiv "laasot oto" – al hashshalem hu chayyayv veeno chayyayv al hechaser, akkol behema ketiv; umar savar: akkol ever veever ketiv. aval ever echad – divre hakkol eno chayyayv ella achat.

Verabbi yochanan amar: machloket beever echad – demar savar: muketre penim shechasru (veheelu) [veheelan] bachutz – chayyayv, umar savar – patur; aval bearbaa vachamishsha evarin – divre hakkol chayyayv al kol ever veever.

Ufeliga deulla, deamar ulla: hakkol modim bemuketre penim shechasru (veheelo) [veheelan] bachutz – shechayyayv. lo nechleku ella bemuketre bachutz shechasru (veheelo) [veheelan] bachutz – demar savar patur, umar savar chayyayv.

Ikka deamri, amar ulla: hakkol modim bemuketre chutz shechasru (veheelo) [veheelan] bachutz shehu patur, lo nechleku ella bemuketre penim shechasru (veheelo) [veheelan] bachutz, demar savar patur, umar savar chayyayv.
(Ufeligi) [ufeliga] daavu dishmuel allishshana kamma deulla; deamar avu dishmuel: keman mahderinan pokin legabbe mizbeach? keman – dela kerabbi yose.
Veeno chayyayv ad sheyyaale kulei. amar rav huna: may tama derabbi yose? dichtiv: "vayyiven noach mizbeach laAdonai".
Amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi shimon? dichtiv: "vayyikkach manoach et gedi haizzim veet hammincha vayyaal al hatztzur laAdonai".
Veiddach name, vehachtiv: "vayyiven mizbeach laAdonai"! hahu guveha bealma. veiddach name, ha ketiv: "vayyikkach manoach"! horaat shaa hayta.
Veibbaet ema: hayeynu tama derabbi shimon – kidtanya, rabbi shimon omer: "mizbeach petach ohel moed"; veen mizbeach bevama; lefichach heela al hassela o al haeven – chayyayv.
Yatza mibbee leh! hachi kaamar: lefichach bishat issur habbamot – heela al hassela o al haeven, chayyayv.
Bae rabbi yose berabbi chanina: keren vechevesh visod veribbua – mahu sheyyeakkevu bevama?
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya, tanya: keren vechevesh veribbua visod – meakkevin bevama gedola, veen meakkevin bevama ketanna.

a: Mishna echad kodashim kesherin veechad kadashim pesulin, shehaya pesulan bakkodesh vehikrivan bachutz – chayyayv.
Hammaale kezayit min haola umin haemurin bachutz – chayyayv.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "asher yaale ola o zavach" – en li ella ola; minnayin lerabbot emure asham, veemure chattat, veemure kodshe kadashim, veemure kadashim kallim? talmud lomar: "zevach".

Minnayin lerabbot hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, vehamenassech sheloshet luggin yayin, usheloshet luggin mayim? talmud lomar: "veel petach ohel moed lo yeviennu" – kol habba lefetach ohel moed, chayyayvin alav bachutz.
Veen li ella kodashim kesherim; minnayin lerabbot pesulin?

Kegon hallan, vehayyotze, vehattame, veshennishchat chutz lizmanno vechutz limkomo, veshekkibbelu pesulin vezarku et damo, vehannittanin lematta shennetanan lemala, vehannittanin lemala shennetanan lematta, vehannittanin bachutz shennetanan bifnim, vehannittanin bifnim shennetanan bachutz, ufesach vechattat shennetanan shello lishman –
Minnayin? talmud lomar: "lo yeviennu laasot" – kol hammitkabbel befetach ohel moed, chayyayvin alav bachutz.
Hammaale kezayit min haola kulei. ola veemureha – in, shelamim veemurehen – la;
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan: ola veemureha mitztarfin lichzayit – lehaalotan bachutz, ulechayyev alehen mishshum piggul notar vetame.
Bishlama haalaat ola – dechalil in, shelamim la; ella piggul venotar vetame – may tama?
Veha tenan: kol happiggulin mitztarfin, vechol hannotarin mitztarfin; kashya piggul appiggul, kashya notar annotar!
Piggul appiggul la kashya – kan befiggul, kan bemachshevet piggul.
Notar annotar la kashya – kan benotar, kan beshennittotru ad shello nizrak haddam.
Umanni? rabbi yehoshua hi; detanya, rabbi yehoshua omer: kol hazzevachim shebbattora shennishtayyer bahen kezayit basar
b: Uchezayit chelev – zorek et haddam.

Chatzi zayit basar vachatzi zayit chelev – eno zorek et haddam. uveola, chatzi zayit basar vachatzi zayit chelev – zorek et haddam, mippene shekkullah kalil. umincha, afillu kullah kayyemet – lo yizrok.
Mincha may avidta? amar rav pappa: minchat nesachim habbaa im hazzevach.

Mishna hakkometz, vehallevona, vehakketoret, uminchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat nesachim, shehikriv meachat mehen kezayit bachutz – chayyayv. rabbi eliezer poter, ad sheyyakriv et kullan. vechullan shehikriv bifnim veshiyyer mehen kezayit, vehikrivo bachutz – chayyayv.
Vechullan shechasru kol shehu, vehikrivo bachutz – patur.
Hammakriv kadashim veemurim bachutz – chayyayv.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: hammaktir kezayit bachutz – chayyayv. chatzi feras bifnim – patur.
Ka salka datin: may patur – patur zar; ammay? haketara hi!
Amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: may patur – patur tzibbur.
Amar rabbi zera, i kashya li – ha kashya li: ha deamar rav ala, beha – afillu rabbi eliezer mode; deha rabbi eliezer lav haketara hi kaamar!
Amar rabba: behaketara dehechol – dechulle alma la peligi.
Ki peligi – behaketara difnim; demar savar: "melo chofnav" davka, umar savar: "melo chofnav" lav davka.
Amar leh abbaye: veha ki ka chetiva "chukka" – behaketara difnim hu dichtiv!
Ella amar abbaye: behaketara bifnim – kulle alma la peligi.
Ki peligi – behaketara dechutz; mar savar: yalfinan penim michutz, umar savar: la yalfinan.
Amar rava: hasheta chutz mechutz la yalfi rabbanan, penim mechutz mibbee?!

Ma hi? detanya: yachol hammaale pachot mikkezayit kometz ufachot mikkezayit emurin, vehamenassech pachot mishsheloshet luggin yayin [pachot] mishshelosha luggin mayim – yehe chayyayv? talmud lomar: "laasot" – al hashshalem chayyayv, veeno chayyayv al hechaser.
Veha pachot mishsheloshet luggin, deit behu kamma zetim – vela yalfi rabbanan chutz michutz!
Ella amar rava: kegon dekavinhu shene chatzae peras

a: Bemana. mar savar: keviut mana milleta hi, umar savar: lav milleta hi.
Amar rava: hasheta leman deamar keviuta demana vela kelum hu – kava shishsha lefar, umashach mehen arbaa vehikrivan bachutz – chayyayv; sheruyin leayil.
Kava arbaa leayil, umashach mehen shelosha vehikrivan bachutz – chayyayv, sheruyin lecheves.
Chasru kol shehu, vehikrivan bachutz – patur.
Rav ashe amar: nissuch mehaketara la yalfi rabbanan.
Af al gav dechutz mechutz, la yalfi. haketara mehaketara yalfi, af al gav dechutz mippenim.
Vechullan shechasru. ibbaya lehu: chesron dechutz, shemeh chesron o la shemeh chesron?
Mi amrinan: kevan dinfak – ippaslu lehu, ma li chaser ma li yater; o dilma, yotze deiteh beeneh – in, deleteh beeneh – la?
Amar abbaye, ta shema: rabbi eliezer poter ad sheyyakriv et kullan.
Amar leh rabba bar rav chanan leabbaye: midderabbi eliezer pashet mar?!
Amar leh, beferush shemia li minneh derav: ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer– ella deiteh beeneh; aval bechesron – modu leh. lav dachasar bachutz? la, dachasar bifnim.
Ta shema: vechullan shechasru vehikrivan bachutz – patur. lav dachasar bachutz? la, dachasar bifnim.
Hammakriv kadashim. ammay? vehaikka chatzitza!
Amar shemuel: keshehafachan.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema shello hafachan; veha manni – rabbi shimon hi, deamar: afillu heela al hassela – chayyayv.
Rav amar: min bemino eno chotzetz.
Mishna mincha shello nikmetza, vehikrivah bachutz – patur. kematzah, vechazar kumetzah letochah, vehikrivo bachutz – chayyayv.
Gemara veammay? (livatteli) [livattelu] shirayim lekometz!
Amar rabbi zera: neemra haketara bakkometz, veneemra haketara bashshirayim; ma haketarat kometz – en kometz mevattel chavero, af haketarat shirayim – en shirayim mevattelin kometz.
Mishna hakkometz vehallevona, shehikriv et echad mehen bachutz – chayyayv. rabbi eliezer poter ad sheyyakriv et hashsheni. echad bifnim veechad bachutz – chayyayv.
Shene beziche levona, shehikriv et echad mehem bachutz – chayyayv. rabbi eliezer poter, ad sheyyakriv et hashsheni. echad bifnim veechad bachutz – chayyayv.
Gemara bae rabbi yitzchak nappacha: kometz, mahu sheyyattir kenegdo bashshirayim? mishra share, o (kalevashey) [ikkeloshe] mikkelesh?
Allibba deman? i allibba derabbi meir, deamar: mefaggelin bachatzi mattir – mishre share!
I allibba derabbanan, deamri: en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir – la mishra share, vela [ikkeloshe] mikkelesh (kalesh)!
Ella allibba derabbi eliezer? rabbi eliezer kerabbanan sevira leh, deamar: en mefaggelin bachatzi mattir!
Ella allibba derabbanan dehacha. may? mishra share, o (kalesh) [ikkeloshe] mikkelesh?
Teku.
Mishna hazzorek miktzat dam bachutz –
b: Chayyayv. rabbi elazar omer: af hamenassech me hechag bechag bachutz – chayyayv. rabbi nechemya omer: sheyare haddam (shehikrivu) [shehikrivan] bachutz – chayyayv.
Gemara amar rava: umode rabbi elazar bedamim.
Detanya, rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: mimmakom sheppasak hu matchil.

Rabbi elazar omer: af hamenassech me hechag [bechag] bachutz. amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi menachem yodfaa: rabbi elazar – beshittat rabbi akiva rabbo amarah, deamar: nissuch hammayim deorayyta. detanya, rabbi akiva omer: "unesacheha" – bishne nissuchim hakkatuv medabber, echad nissuch hammayim veechad nissuch hayyayin.

Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: i – ma lehallan sheloshet luggin, af kan sheloshet luggin?! veha rabbi elazar "me hechag" kaamar! i – ma lehallan bishar yemot hashshana, af kan bishar yemot hashshana?! [verabbi elazar] "bechag" kaamar!
Ishtemitteh ha deamar rabbi assi; deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi nechuneya ish bikat bet chortan: eser netiot, arava venissuch hammayim – halacha lemoshe missinay.
Tanu rabbanan: hamenassech sheloshet luggin mayim bechag bachutz – chayyayv. rabbi elazar (berabbi shimon) omer: im millean leshem chag – chayyayv.
May benayyhu? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: beyesh shiur bemayim kamippalgi.
Rav pappa amar:

a: Bekarvu nesachim bammidbar peligi.
Ravina amar: bilmedin nissuch hammayim minnissuch hayyayin peligi.
Tanu rabbanan: hamenassech shelosha luggin yayin bachutz – chayyayv. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: vehu shekkiddeshan bichli.
May benayyhu? amar rav adda bar rav yitzchak: berutze middot ikka benayyhu.
Rava bereh derabba amar: karvu nesachim bevama ikka benayyhu.
Uviflugeta dehane tannae – detanya: bamat yachid enah tzericha nesachim. divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: teuna nesachim.
Vehane tannae kehane tannae – detanya: "ki tavou" – lehateinah nesachim levama gedola hakkatuv medabber.
Atta omer levama gedola; o eno afillu bama ketanna? keshehu omer: "el eretz moshvotechem asher ani noten lachem" – hare bevama hannoheget lechullechem hakkatuv medabber. divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: "ki tavou" – lehateinah nesachim (bevama) [levama] ketanna hakkatuv medabber.
Atta omer levama ketanna; o eno ella levama gedola? keshehu omer: "el eretz moshvotechem" – hare bevama hannoheget bechol moshavot hakkatuv medabber.
Keshettimtza lomar; ledivre rabbi yishmael – lo karvu nesachim bammidbar, uledivre rabbi akiva – karvu nesachim bammidbar.
Rabbi nechemya omer: sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz – chayyayv.
Amar rabbi yochanan: [tanna] rabbi nechemya kedivre haomer shirayim meakkevin.

Metivi: rabbi nechemya omer: sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz – chayyayv. amar lo rabbi akiva: vahalo sheyare haddam sheyare mitzva hem! amar lo: evarin ufedarin yochichu – shehen sheyare mitzva, vehammakrivan bachutz chayyayv! amar lo: lo; im amarta beevarim ufedarim – shehen techillat avoda, tomar bishyare haddam sheenan techillat avoda?!
Veim ita, lema leh: hane name meakkevi! teyuveta.

Vehasheta deamar rav adda bar ahava: machloket beshirayim happenimiyyim, aval beshirayim hachitzonim – divre hakkol la meakkevi; ki kaamar rabbi nechemya – beshirayim happenimim, ki tanya hahi – beshirayim hachitzonim.
Verabbi akiva la yada may kaamar rabbi nechemya; hu savar: rabbi nechemya shirayim chitzonim amar, veka mahdar leh shirayim hachitzonim. verabbi nechemya – lidvarav derabbi akiva kaamar.
Mishna hammolek et haof bifnim veheela bachutz – chayyayv. malak bachutz veheela bachutz – patur. hashshochet et haof bifnim veheela bachutz – patur.
b: Shachat bachutz veheela bachutz – chayyayv.
Nimtza derech hechshero bifnim – peturo bachutz, derech hechshero mibbachutz – peturo bifnim.
Rabbi shimon omer: kol shechayyayvin alav bachutz – chayyayvin al kayyotze bo bifnim sheheela bachutz; chutz min hashshochet bifnim umaale bachutz.
Gemara hay "hechshero"?! chiyyuvo hu! teni "chiyyuvo".
Rabbi shimon omer [vechulei]. ahecha kae?

Illema aresha kae: hammolek of bifnim veheela bachutz – chayyayv, malak bachutz veheela bachutz – patur. vaamar leh rabbi shimon: ki hechi difnim michayyayv, bachutz name michayyayv. hay "kol shechayyayvin alav bachutz"?! "kol shechayyayvin alav bifnim" mibbee leh!
Ella ki hechi divchutz la michayyayv, bifnim name la lichayyayv? hay "kol sheen chayyayvin alav bachutz" mibbee leh!

Ella assefa kae: hashshochet of bifnim veheela bachutz – patur. shachat bachutz veheela bachutz – chayyayv. vaamar leh rabbi shimon: ki hechi devifnim la michayyayv, bachutz name la michayyayv. hay "kol sheen chayyayvin" mibbee leh!
Ella ki hechi devachutz michayyayv, bifnim name michayyayv? ha katane: chutz min hashshochet bifnim vehammaale bachutz!
Amar zeeri: shechitat behema ballayla ikka benayyhu. vehachi kaamar: [vechen] hashshochet behema bifnim ballayla veheela bachutz – patur. shachat bachutz ballayla veheela bachutz – chayyayv.
Rabbi shimon omer: kol shechayyayvin alav bachutz – chayyayvin al keyotze bo bifnim veheela bachutz, chutz min hashshochet of bifnim veheela bachutz.
Rava amar: kabbala bichli chol ikka benayyhu. vehachi kaamar: [vechen] hamekabbel bichli chol bifnim veheela bachutz – patur. hamekabbel bichli chol bachutz veheela bachutz – chayyayv.
Rabbi shimon omer: kol shechayyayvin alav bachutz, chayyayvin al kayyotze bo bifnim veheelo bachutz, chutz min hashshochet of bifnim veheelo bachutz.

Hasheta detane avu dishmuel bar rav yitzchak: hammolek of bifnim veheelo bachutz – chayyayv, malak bachutz veheela bachutz – patur, verabbi shimon michayyayv; rabbi shimon hatam kae – vetane: kol shechayyayvin alav bifnim veheela bachutz – chayyayvin alav bachutz.
Mishna chattat shekkibbel damah bechos echad; natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim, bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz – chayyayv, shekkullo rauy bifnim.

Kibbel damah bishte kosot; natan shenehem bifnim – patur. shenehem bachutz – chayyayv. echad bifnim veechad bachutz – patur. echad bachutz veechad bifnim – chayyayv al hachitzon, vehappenimi mechapper.

Lema haddavar dome? lemafrish chattato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha, veachar kach nimtzet harishona, vahare shetehen omdot. shachat shetehen bifnim – patur. shetehen bachutz – chayyayv. achat bifnim veachat bachutz – patur. achat bachutz veachat bifnim – chayyayv al hachitzona, vehappenimit mechapperet.
Keshem sheddamah poter et besarah, kach hi poteret et besar chavertah.

a: Gemara bishlama bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim – shekkullo rauy lihyot bifnim; aval bifnim veheelan bachutz – shirayim ninhu!
Ha manni – rabbi nechemya hi, deamar: sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz – chayyayv.

I rabbi nechemya, ema sefa: kibbel damah bishne kosot; natan shenehem bifnim – patur. shenehem bachutz – chayyayv. echad bifnim veechad bachutz – patur. vehaamar rabbi nechemya: sheyare haddam shehikrivan bachutz – chayyayv!
Sefa atan letanna kamma derabbi elazar berabbi shimon, deamar: kos ose dachuy lachavero.
Lema haddavar dome? lemafrish chattato veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, veachar kach nimtzet harishona.
"Lema haddavar dome" lema li? ha manni – rabbi hi; deamar: avuda bishat haferasha – meta.
Vehachi kaamar: tama deavda; ha hifrish shete chattaot leachrayut – chada minnayyhu meikkara ola hi.
Vechidrav huna amar rav, deamar rav huna amar rav: asham shennittak liriyyay, ushechato setam – kasher leola.
Mi dame?! hatam asham zachar, veola zachar; aval chattat – nekeva hi! amar rav chiyyay miyyostinya: bisir nasi.
Hadaran alach hashshochet vehammaale
Mishna parat chattat shesserafah chutz miggittah, vechen sair hammishtalleach shehikriv bachutz – patur.
Shenneemar: "veel petach ohel moed lo hevio" – kol sheen rauy lavo el petach ohel moed, en chayyayvin alav.
Harovea, vehannirba, vehammuketze, vehanneevad, vehammechir, [vehaetnan], vehakkilayim, vehatterefa, veyotze dofen; shehikrivan bachutz – patur.
Shenneemar: "lifne mishkan Adonai" – kol sheen rauy lavo lifne mishkan Adonai, en chayyayvin alav.
Baale mumin – ben baale mumin kevuin, ben
b: Baale mumin ovrin; shehikrivan bachutz – patur. rabbi shimon omer: baale mumin kevuin – patur, baale mumin ovrin – chayyayv belo taase.
Torim shello higgia zemannan, uvene yona sheavar zemannan, shehikrivan bachutz – patur. rabbi shimon omer: bene yona sheavar zemannan – patur, vetorim shello higgia zemannan – belo taase.

Oto veet beno umechussar zeman – patur. rabbi shimon omer: hare ze belo taase; sherabbi shimon omer: kol shehu rauy lavo leachar zeman – hare ze belo taase veen bo karet. vachachamim omrim: kol sheen bo karet – en bo lo taase.
Mechussar zeman – ben begufo, ben bivalav.
Ezehu mechussar zeman bivalav? hazzav vehazzava vehayyoledet vehammetzora, shehikrivu chattatam vaashamam bachutz – peturin. olotehen veshalmehen bachutz – chayyayvin.
Hammaale mibbesar chattat, mibbesar asham, mibbesar kodshe kadashim, mibbesar kadashim kallim, umotar haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, usheyare menachot;
Vehayyotzek, vehappotet, vehabbolel, vehammoleach, vehammenif, vehammaggish; vehamesadder et hashshulechan, vehammetiv et hannerot, vehakkometz, vehamekabbel damim bachutz – patur.
Veen chayyayvin alav lo mishshum zarut, velo mishshum tumea, velo mishshum mechussar begadim, velo mishshum [shello] rechutz yadayim veraglayim.

Ad shello hukam hammishkan – hayu habbamot muttarot, vaavoda bivchorot; umishshehukam hammishkan – neesru habbamot, vaavoda bakkohanim. kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim, vekadashim kallim bechol machane yisrael. bau laggilgal – hutteru habbamot; kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim, vekadashim kallim bechol makom.

Bau leshilo – neesru habbamot. velo haya sham tikra; ella bet avanim bilvad millemattan, vehayyeriot millemalan; vehi hayta "menucha". kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim, vekadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechol haroe.
Bau lenov vegivon – hutteru habbamot. kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim, vekadashim kallim bechol are yisrael.
Bau lirushalayim – neesru habbamot velo haya lahen hetter, vehi hayta "nachala". kodshe kodashim neechalin lifnim min hakkelaim, kadashim kallim umaaser sheni lifnim min hachoma.
Kol hakkodashim shehikdishan bishat issur habbamot, vehikrivan bishat issur habbamot mibbachutz – hare ellu baase velo taase, vechayyayvin alav karet.

Hikdishan bishat hetter habbamot, vehikrivan bishat issur habbamot bachutz – hare ellu baase velo taase, veen chayyayvin alehen karet. hikdishan bishat issur habbamot, vehikrivan bishat hetter habbamot – hare ellu baase, veen bahen lo taase.

Veellu kadashim kerevin bammishkan: kadashim shehukedshu lemishkan, korbenot tzibbur kerevin bammishkan, vekorbenot hayyachid bevama. korbenot hayyachid shehukedshu lammishkan – yakrivu bammishkan, veim hikrivan bevama – patur.
Uma ben bamat yachid levamat tzibbur? semicha, ushechitat tzafon,

a: Umattan saviv, utenufa, vehaggasha. rabbi yehuda omer: en mincha bevama, vechihun, uvigde sharet, uchele sharet, vereach nichoach, umechitza ledamim, verichutz yadayim veraglayim.
Aval hazzeman, hannotar vehattame – shavin baze uvaze.
Gemara may chutz miggittah? amar resh lakish: chutz mimmakom habbaduk lah. amar lo rabbi yochanan: vahalo kol eretz yisrael beduka hi!
Ella amar rabbi yochanan: kegon sheshshechatah lifnim min chomat yerushalayim.
Velokma kegon sheshshechatah chutz lachoma shello keneged happetach! deamar rav adda bar ahava: shechatah shello keneged happetach – pesula, shenneemar: "veshachat... vehizza" –

Ma hazzaatah keneged happetach, af shechitatah keneged happetach. vechi tema dela makkesh, veha ittemar: shechatah shello keneged happetach – rabbi yochanan omer: pesula – "veshachat... vehizza". resh lakish amar: keshera – "el michutz lammachane veshachat".
Veittemar name, serafah shello keneged happetach – rabbi yochanan amar: pesula, verabbi oshaya amar: keshera. rabbi yochanan amar pesula – "vesaraf... vehizza".
Verabbi oshaya amar keshera – "al pirshah yisrof"; mekom shepporeshet lemita, sham tehe serefatah.
Amri: la mibbaya kaamar; la mibbaya chutz lachoma – derachoke rachaka; ella afillu lifnim min hachoma – dekarove karva, veema tittachshar – ka mashma lan.
Amar mar, amar lo rabbi yochanan: vahalo kol eretz yisrael beduka hi. bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: yarad mabbul leeretz yisrael, umar savar: lo yarad.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, ushenehem mikra echad darshu: "ben adam emor lah at eretz lo metohara hi lo gushmah beyom zaam".

Rabbi yochanan savar, atmohe matma kera: eretz yisrael, mi la metohara at?! kelum yardu alayich geshamim beyom zaam?! veresh lakish savar: kifshateh – aretz lo metohara at; mi lo yardu alayich geshamim beyom zaam?!
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: chatzerot hayu birushalayim benuyot al hassela, vetachtehen chalul mippene kever hattehom, umeviin nashim meubbarot veyoldot, umegaddelot sham benehem lappara.
Umeviin shevavrim, veal gabbehen delatot, vetinokot yoshvin alehen, vechosot shel even beyadan, umilleu veyashvu bimkoman.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: maala asu bappara.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: paam echad matzu atzamot belishkat dir haetzim, uvikkeshu ligzor tumea al yerushalayim. amad rabbi yehoshua al raglav veamar: lo busha uchelimma hi lanu, shennigzor tumea al ir avotenu?! ayye mete mabbul? ayye mete nevuchadnetztzar?
Middekaamar hachi, lav lememra dela havo? uletamaych, haruge nevuchadnetztzar hachi name dela havo?! ella havo, ufanninhu; hacha name – havo ufanninhu. vei ippanno,
b: Ha ippeno! nehi deippanno mirushalayim, mikkulla eretz yisrael la ippanno.
Ikka deamri, etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: ayye mete mabbul? ayye mete nevuchadnetztzar? may, lav middehane havo – hane name havo? midde irya?! ha kiditeh veha kiditeh.
Etiveh: "mikkol asher becharava metu" – bishlama ledidi, deamena yarad mabbul leeretz yisrael – mishshum hachi metu. ella ledidach, ammay metu? mishshum havela.
Kidrav chisda, deamar rav chisda: berotchin kilkelu, uverotchin niddonu; dichtiv hacha: "vayyashokku hammayim", uchetiv hatam: "vachamat hammelech shachacha".

Ikka deamri, etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: "mikkol asher becharava metu" – bishlama ledidi, deamena lo yarad mabbul leeretz yisrael – mishshum hachi havay charava. ella ledidach, may charava? charava shehayta meikkara.
Veammay kare leh charava? kidrav chisda. deamar rav chisda: bedor hammabbul lo nigzera gezera al dagim shebbayyam, shenneemar: "mikkol asher becharava metu" – velo dagim shebbayyam.
Bishlama leman deamar lo yarad mabbul leeretz yisrael – hayeynu dekam rema hatam. ella leman deamar yarad, rema hecha kam? amar rabbi yannay: guriyyot hichnisu batteva.

Vehaamar rabba bar bar chana: ledidi chaze li urezila derema (bat) [bar] yome, vehave kehar tavor. vehar tavor kamma have – arbein parse; meshacha detzavvereh – telata parse, marbata deresha – parsa ufalga, rema kabba usechar yardena.
Amar rabbi yochanan: rosho hichnisu latteva. vehaamar mar: marbata deresha parsa ufalga! ella rosh chotmo hichnisu latteva.
Veha amar rabbi yochanan: lo yarad mabbul leeretz yisrael! ledivre resh lakish kaamar.
Veha kasagya teva! amar resh lakish: karnav kashru batteva. vehaamar rav chisda: anshe dor hammabbul berotchin kilkelu uverotchin niddonu!
Uletamaych, teva hechi sagya? veod, og melech habbashan hecha kae? ella nes naasa lahem, shennitztannenu betzidde hatteva.

Ulerabbi shimon [ben lakish] – nehi name deyarad mabbul leeretz yisrael; veha la pash! deamar resh lakish: lamma nikra shemah "metzula"? shekkol mete mabbul nitztallelu sham. verabbi yochanan amar: lamma nikra shemah "shinar"? shekkol mete mabbul ninaru sham. i efshar dela iddevaku.
Amar rabbi avahu: lamma nikra shemah "shinar"? shemmenaeret ashireha. veha kachazenan dehavu! telata dare la mashchi.

Amar rabbi amme: kol haochel meafarah shel bavel – keillu ochel besar avotav. tanya name hachi: kol haochel meafarah shel bavel – keillu ochel besar avotav. veyesh omrim: keillu ochel shekatzim uremasim.
Sair hammishtalleach.
Ureminhi: o "korban" – shomea ani afillu kodshe bedek habbayit shennikreu korban, shenneemar: "vannakrev et korban Adonai"?
Talmud lomar: "veel petach ohel moed lo hevio" – mi sherauy lavo beohel moed; yatzu kodshe bedek habbayit – sheenan reuyin.
Otzi et ellu – sheenan reuyin; velo otzi et sair hammishtalleach – shehu rauy lavo el petach ohel moed! talmud lomar: "laAdonai" – lehotzi sair hammishtalleach, sheeno meyuchad laAdonai.
La kashya; kan kodem hagerala, kan leachar hagerala. achar hagerala name, haikka vidduy!
Ella amar rav manni: la kashya; kan kodem vidduy, kan leachar vidduy.
Harovea vehannirba.
Veha name tippok li mippetach ohel moed"!

a: Bishlama rovea venirba – mashkachat leh deakdeshinhu meikkara, vahadar (revao) [irvau].
Ella muketze veneevad – en adam oser davar sheeno shello! bekadashim kallim, veallibba derabbi yose haggelili – deamar: kadashim kallim mamon bealim hu.
Detanya: "umaala maal baAdonai" – lerabbot kodashim kallim, shehen mamono. divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Hilkach, rovea venirba – devar erva. muketze veneevad – avoda zara, bekadashim kallim.
Etnan, umechir, kilayim, yotze dofen – bivladot kadashim.
Kasavar: valde kadashim – bahavayaytan hen kedoshim.
Baale mumin vechulei, oto veet beno vechulei.
Utzerichi; dei tena baale mumin – mishshum dimisi; aval torin, dela meisi – ema la, demodu leh lerabbi shimon;
Vei tena torin – mishshum dela (chazu) [ichazo] veiddecho; aval baale mumin, deichazo veiddecho – ema la, demode lehu rabbi shimon lerabbanan;
Vei tena hane tarte – mishshum difsula degufayyhu; aval oto veet beno, difsula mealma kaate la – ema modu leh rabbanan lerabbi shimon; tzericha.
Shehaya rabbi shimon omer: may tama derabbi shimon?
Amar rabbi ila amar resh lakish, deamar kera: "lo taasun kechol asher anachnu osim po hayyom" – amar lehu moshe leyisrael: ki ayylitu laaretz – yesharot takrivu, chovot lo takrivu.
Vegilgal legabbe shilo mechussar zeman hu, vekaamar lehu moshe: "lo taasun".
Amar rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: i hachi,
b: Milke name lilke! allema amar rabbi zera: hakkatuv nitteko laase?
Hane mille lerabbanan, lerabbi shimon hachi name.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: penim degilgal legabbe shilo – kechutz dame.
Rabba amar: tameh derabbi shimon – kidtanya, rabbi shimon omer: minnayin lazzoveach pesach bevamat yachid bishat issur habbamot, shehu belo taase? talmud lomar: "lo tuchal lizboach et happasach".
Yachol af bishat hetter habbamot ken? talmud lomar: "beachad shearecha" – lo amarti lecha ella beshaa shekkol yisrael nichnasin beshaar echad.
Emat? i nema achar chatzot – karet name michayyayv! ella lav kodem chatzot?
Leolam leachar chatzot, uvishat hetter habbamot kae.
Veha bishat issur habbamot kaamar! issur bama lo, hetter bama lachavero.
Mechussar zeman kulei. vehane bene ashamot ninhu?! amar zeeri: teni metzora bahadayyhu.
Olotehen veshalmehen. vehane bene shelamim ninhu?! amar rav sheshet: teni nazir. dizeri kavuha tannae, derav sheshet la kavuha tannae.
Amar rabbi chilkiyya (deve) rav tovi: lo shanu ella lishmo; aval shello lishmo – chayyayv, hoil verauy leshello lishmo bifnim.
I hachi, lishmo name nichayyayv – hoil verauy leshello lishmo bifnim! bae akira.
Matkef la rav huna: vechi yesh lecha davar sheeno kasher lishmo, vechasher shello lishmo?! velo?! vahare

a: Pesach bishar yemot hashshana – deeno kasher lishmo, vechasher shello lishmo! pesach bishar yemot hashshana – shelamim ninhu.
Lema mesayyay leh: yachol sheani motzi af olat mechussar zeman bivalim, vaasham nazir vaasham metzora?
Talmud lomar: "shor" – mikkol makom, "kesev" – mikkol makom, "ez" – mikkol makom. veillu chattat – shayyeyra;
Bemay askinan? ilema bizmanno – may irya asham? afillu chattat name! ella shello lizmanno.
Uvemay? ilema lishmo – asham ammay chayyayv? ella lav shello lishmo? leolam bizmanno veshello lishmo;
Verabbi eliezer hi, deamar: makkeshinan asham lechattat.
Utena tafel, vehu haddin ikkar.
Ta shema: yachol sheani merabbe olat mechussar zeman – begufah, vechattat – ben begufah ben bivalim?
Talmud lomar: "veel petach ohel moed" – kol sheeno rauy lavo befetach ohel moed, en chayyayvin alehen. veillu asham – shayyeyre;
Bemay askinan? ilema lishmo – asham name liftereh! ella lav shello lishmo?
Leolam shello lishmo, verabbi eliezer hi – demakkesh asham lechattat. tena ikkar, vechol shekken letafel.

Ta shema: dechi ata rav dimi amar, tana deve rabbi levay: yachol sheani motzi af olat mechussar zeman bivalim, asham nazir vaasham metzora; minnayin? venasev lehu talmuda lechiyyuva, vela yadana may hi.
May talmuda? amar ravina: "shor" – mikkol makom, "kesev" – mikkol makom, "ez" – mikkol makom. ha may rumeya? kidamrat!
Amar rav nachman: mishshum derame detana deve rabbi levay addetane levi: asham nazir vaasham metzora sheshshechatan shello lishman – kesherin, velo alu labbealim leshum chova.
Shechatan mechussar zeman bivalim, o shehayu vene shete shanim ushechatan – pesulin.
Umeshanne rav dimi: la kashya; kan lishmo, kan shello lishmo.
Rav ashe rame matnitin abbarayyta, umeshanne: kan lishmo, vechan shello lishmo.
Lema tehve teyuveteh derav huna?
Amar lecha rav huna: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehifrish shete ashamot leachrayut, dechad minnayyhu meikkara ola hi;
b: Kidrav huna amar rav. deamar rav huna amar rav: asham shennittak liriyya, ushechato setam – kasher laola.

Hammaale mibbesar chattat [vechulei]. tanu rabbanan: minnayin lammaale mibbesar chattat, umibbesar asham, umibbesar kodshe kadashim, umibbesar kadashim kallim, umimmotar haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, usheyare menachot – sheppatur?
Talmud lomar: "ola" – ma ola shehi reuya lehaalaa, af kol sheruya lehaalaa.
Minnayin sheaf hayyotzek, vehabbolel, vehappotet, vehammoleach, vehammenif, vehammaggish, vehamesadder hashshulchan, vehammetiv et hannerot, vehakkometz, vehamekabbel bachutz – sheppatur?
Talmud lomar: "asher yaale ola o zavach" – ma haalaa shehi gemar avoda, af kol shehu gemar avoda.
Ad shello hukam hammishkan [vechulei]. yatev rav huna bar rav kattina kammeh derav chisda, veka kare: "vayyishlach et naare bene yisrael". amar leh, hachi amar rabbi assi: karvu ufasku.
Sevar leotoveh mimmatnitin; shameh dekaamar mishshemeh derav adda bar ahava: ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar – enah teuna hefshet venittuach; otveh barayyta deshavya bechullehu.
Detanya: ad shello hukam hammishkan – habbamot muttarot, vaavoda bivchorot, vehakkol kesherin lehikkarev; behema, chayya vaof, zecharim unekevot, temimin uvaale mumin, tehorin aval lo temein.
Vehakkol karvu olot. veola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar – teuna hefshet venittuach. vegoyim bizman hazze rashshain laasot ken.
Tannae hi; detanya: "vegam hakkohanim hanniggashim el Adonai yitkaddashu" – rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: zo perishut bechorot. rabbi omer: zo perishut nadav vaavihu.
Bishlama leman deamar zo perishut nadav vaavihu – hayeynu dichtiv: "hu asher dibber Adonai lemor bikrovay ekkadesh".
Ella leman deamar zo perishut bechorot – hecha remiza? dichtiv: "venoadti shamma livne yisrael venikdash bichvodi" – al tikre "bichvodi", ella "(bimchubbadayy) [bichvudayy]".

Davar ze amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe velo yadu, ad shemmetu bene aharon. kevan shemmetu bene aharon, amar lo: aharon achi, lo metu banecha ella lehakedish shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu. kevan sheyyada aharon shebbanav yedue makom hen, shatak vekibbel sachar; shenneemar: "vayyiddom aharon".

Vechen bedavid hu omer: "dom laAdonai vehitcholel lo" – af al pi shemmappil lecha chalalim chalalim, at shetok. vechen bishlomo hu omer: "et lachashot veet ledabber" – peamim sheshshotek umekabbel sachar al hashshetika, peamim medabber umekabbel sachar al haddibbur.

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "nora elohim mimmikdashecha"? al tikre "mimmikdashecha" ella "mimmekuddashecha" – beshaa sheose hakkadosh baruch hu din bikdoshav, mityayre umitalle umithallel.
Ella kashya ola! tere tannae hi; detanya, rabbi yishmael omer: kelalot neemru besinay, uferatot beohel moed.
Rabbi akiva omer: kelalot uferatot neemru besinay, venishnu beohel moed, venishtalleshu bearvot moav.

Amar mar: hakkol kesherin lehakeriv. mena hane mille? amar rav huna, deamar kera: "vayyiven noach mizbeach laAdonai vayyikkach mikkol habbehema hattehora umikkol of hattahor"; behema – kemashmao. chayya – bichlal behema.

a: Zecharim unekevot, temimin uvaale mumin – deamar mar: tammut vezachrut bivhema, veen tammut vezachrut beofot.
Veittakkash behema leof.

Temimin uvaale mumin – leappoke mechussar ever, dela. amar rabbi elazar: minnayin limchussar ever shenneesar livne noach? talmud lomar: "umikkol hachay mikkol basar" – amra tora: have behema shechayyin rashe evarin shellah.
Vedilma lemaote terefa? hahu millechayyot zera" nafka.
Hanicha leman deamar terefa enah yoledet, ella leman deamar terefa yoledet – may ikka lememar? haamar kera: "ittach" – bedomin lach.
Vedilma noach gufeh terefa hava? "tamim" ketiv beh. vedilma tamim bidrachav? "tzaddik" ketiv beh.
Vedilma "tamim" – bidrachav, "tzaddik" – bemaasav? i salka datach denoach gufeh terefa hava, mi kaamar leh lenoach: dichvavtach ayyel, shelemim la teayyel?!
Umeachar denafka lan meittach", "lechayyot zera" lema li? mahu detema: "ittach" – letzavta bealma, afillu zaken afillu saris; kamashma lan.
Tehorin aval lo temein. umi havo temein utehorin behahi shata?! amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: meotan shello neevda bahen avera.
Mena havo yadi? kidrav chisda. deamar rav chisda: heeviran lifne hatteva; kol shehatteva kolattan – beyadua shehu tahor, en hatteva kolattan – beyadua shehen temein.
Rabbi avahu amar, amar kera: "vehabbaim zachar unekeva" – habbain mealehen.
Amar mar: vehakkol karvu olot. olot in, shelamim la. veha ketiv: "vayyizbechu zevachim shelamim laAdonai parim"! ella ema: hakkol karvu olot [ushelamim.

Vehatanya: aval shelamim la, ki im olot.] olot in, shelamim la! keman deamar lo kervu shelamim bene noach – deittemar: rabbi elazar verabbi yose bar chanina, chad amar: kervu shelamim bene noach, vechad amar: lo kervu.

May tama deman deamar kervu shelamim bene noach? dichtiv: "vehevel hevi gam hu mibbechorot tzono umechelvehen" – ezehu davar shechelbo karev legabbe mizbeach, veen kullo karev legabbe mizbeach? heve omer: ze shelamim.
May tama deman deamar lo kervu? dichtiv: "uri tzafon uvoi teman" – titnaer umma shemmaaseha batztzafon, vetavo umma shemmaaseha batztzafon uvaddarom.
Umar name, hachtiv: "umechelvehen"! mishshamminehon [didhu].
Umar name, hachtiv: "uri tzafon"! [hahu] bekibbutz galiyyot hu dichtiv.
Veha ketiv: "vayyomer moshe gam atta titten beyadenu zevachim veolot veasinu laAdonai elohenu"! zevachim laachila, veolot lehakerava.
Veha ketiv: "vayyikkach yitro [choten moshe] ola uzevachim"! hahu leachar mattan tora hu dichtiv.

Hanicha leman deamar: [yitro] achar mattan tora haya; ella leman deamar: [yitro] kodem mattan tora haya – may ikka lememar? deittemar: bene rabbi chiyyay verabbi yehoshua ben levi; chad amar: yitro kodem mattan tora haya, vechad amar: yitro achar mattan tora haya. leman deamar yitro kodem mattan tora haya – kasavar shelamim hikrivu bene noach.

Ketannae: "vayyishma yitro chohen midyan" – ma shemua shama, uva venitgayyer? rabbi yehoshua omer: milchemet amalek shama, shehare ketiv betziddo: "vayyachalosh yehoshua et amalek veet ammo lefi charev".

Rabbi elazar hammodai omer: mattan tora shama [uva], shekkeshennittena tora leyisrael haya kolo holech missof haolam vead sofo, vechol [malche] ummot haolam achazatan reada behechlehen veamru shira, shenneemar: "uvehechalo kullo omer kavod".

Nitkabbetzu kullam etzel bilam harasha, veamru lo: ma kol hehamon asher shamanu? shemma mabbul ba laolam (amar lahem) – "Adonai lammabbul yashav"? [amar lahem]: "vayyeshev Adonai melech leolam" – kevar nishba hakkadosh baruch hu sheeno mevi mabbul laolam.
Amru lo: mabbul shel mayim eno mevi, aval mabbul shel esh mevi – shenneemar: "ki (hinne) baesh Adonai nishpat". amar lahen: kevar nishba sheeno mashchit kol basar.

Ume kol hehamon hazze sheshshamanu? amar lahem: chemda tova yesh lo bevet genazav, shehayta genuza etzlo tesha meot shivim vearbaa dorot kodem shennivra haolam; uvikkesh littenah levanav, shenneemar: "Adonai oz leammo yitten". [miyyad] patchu kullam veamru: "Adonai yevarech et ammo vashshalom".
Rabbi eliezer omer: keriat yam suf shama uva, shenneemar: "vayhi chishmoa kol malche haemori". veaf rachav hazzona amra lishluche yehoshua: "ki shamanu et asher hovish Adonai et me yam suf".
May shena hatam, daamar (leh) "velo haya vam od ruach"; umay shena hacha, dekaamar: "velo kama od ruach beish"?
b: Daafillu ikkashshoye name la ikkashshu. umena yada? deamar mar: en lach kol sar venagid shello ba al rachav hazzona.

Amru: bat eser shanim hayta kesheyyatzu yisrael mimmitzrayim, vezinneta [kol] arbaim shana shehayu yisrael bammidbar. achar chamishshim shana nitgayyeyra, amra: "yehe machul li bischar chevel challon ufishtim".
Amar mar: vegoyim bizman hazze rashshain laasot ken. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "dabber el bene yisrael" – bene yisrael metzuvin al shechute chutz, veen haggoyim metzuvin al shechute chutz.
Lefichach kol echad veechad bone lo bama leatzmo, umakriv aleha kol ma sheyyirtze. amar rabbi yaakov bar acha amar rav assi: asur lesayyeyan velaasot shelichutan. amar rabba: uleoroyinhu shere.

Ki ha deifra hormiz immeh deshabbur malka shaddara kurebana lerava, shelacha leh: "asseku nihaleh leshem shamayim". amar lehu lerav safra ulerav acha bar huna: zilu udevaru tere uleme gulae, vachazo hecha demasseka yamma sirton; ushekulu tzive chadte, veappiku nura mimmara chadta, veasseku nihaleh leshem shamayim.

Amar leh abbaye: keman – kerabbi elazar ben shammua. detanya, rabbi elazar ben shammua omer: ma mizbeach – shello yishtammesh bo hedyot, af etzim – shello yishtammesh bahen hedyot. veha mode rabbi elazar ben shammua bevama!
Detanya, katuv echad omer: "vayyitten david leornan bammakom shikle zahav mishkal shesh meot vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyiken david et haggoren veet habbakar bechesef shekalim chamishshim"; ha ketzad?
Gove mikkol shevet vashevet chamishshim, shehen shesh meot. rabbi omer mishshum abba yose ben dostay: bakar [veetzim] umekom mizbeach bachamishshim, vechol habbayit kullo beshesh meot.
