Rabbi elazar ben shammua omer: bakar veetzim umekom mizbeach bachamishshim, vechol habbayit kullo beshesh meot; dichtiv: "vayyomer aravna el david: yikkach veyaal adoni hammelech [hattov beenav], ree habbakar laola vehammoriggim [uchele habbakar] laetzim". verava amar lach: hatam name bechadte.
May moriggim? amar ulla: mitta shel turebel. may mitta shel turebel? amar abbaye: izza dekurkesa dedayyshan dishae. amar abbaye: may kera? "hinne samtich lemorag charutz chadash baal pifiyyot".
Makre leh rava livreh, verame leh kerae ahadade; ketiv: "vayyitten david leornan vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyiken david vegomer"; ha ketzad? gove mikkol shevet vashevet chamishshim, shehen shesh meot.
Veakkatti kashyayn ahadade – hatam kesef, hacha zahav! ella hachi kaamar: gove kesef bemishkal shesh meot zahav.
Kadashim kallim neechalim [bechol machane yisrael]. amar rav huna: bechol mekomot yisrael, aval machane la have.

Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna: umachanot bemidbar la havay?! veha tanya: keshem shemmachane bammidbar, kach machane birushalayim; mirushalayim lehar habbayit – machane yisrael, mehar habbayit leshaar nikkanor – machane leviyya,
Mikkan veelach – machane shechina, vehen hen kelaim shebbammidbar.
Ella ema: bechol mekom machane yisrael. peshita! mahu detema: ippesilu beyotze; ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! amar kera: "venasa ohel moed" – af al pi shennasa, ohel moed hu.
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: od acheret hayta, vechel ezrat nashim hi, velo hayu onshin aleha. uveshilo lo hayu ella shene machanot bilvad.
He minnayyhu la hava? amar rabba: mistabbera demachane leviyya havay; dei salka datach machane leviyya la havay –

a: Nimtzeu zavin utemee metim mishtallechin chutz lemachane achat, vehattora amra: "velo yetammeu et machanehem" –
Ten machane laze umachane laze.
Amar leh rava: ella may, machane yisrael la havay?! nimtzeu zavin umetzorain mishtallechin lemakom echad, vehattora amra: "badad yeshev" – shello yeshev tame acher immo!
Ella leolam kullehu telata havu; umay lo hayu ella shete machanot – liklita. mikkelal divmidbar havay kalta machane leviyya?
In; veha tanya: "vesamti lecha makom" – bechayyecha makom, mekomecha; "asher yanus shamma". melammed shemmaglin bammidbar. lehechan golin? lemachane leviyya.
Mikkan amru: ben levi sheharag – gole mippelech lefelech, veim gala lefilko – pilko kolto.
May kera? amar rav acha bereh derav ika: "ki veir miklato yeshev" – ir shekkelatattu kevar.

Bau laggilgal. tanu rabbanan: kol niddar veniddav – haya karev bevama, sheen niddar veniddav – en karev bevama. mincha unezirut – kerevin bevama. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: lo kervu yachid ella olot ushelamim bilvad.

Rabbi yehuda omer: kol shehatztzibbur vehayyachid makrivin beohel moed shebbammidbar – makrivin beohel moed shebbaggilgal. uma ben ohel moed shebbammidbar leven ohel moed shebbaggilgal? ohel moed shebbammidbar lo hayu bamot muttarot, ohel moed shebbaggilgal hayu habbamot muttarot. uvamato shebberosh gaggo lo haya makriv aleha ella ola ushelamim.

Vachachamim omrim: kol shehatztzibbur makrivin beohel moed shebbammidbar – makrivin beohel moed shebbaggilgal; vechan vechan lo karvu yachid ella ola ushelamim bilvad. rabbi shimon omer: af tzibbur lo hikrivu ella pesachim
b: Vechovot shekkavua lahen zeman.
May tama derabbi meir? deamar kera: "lo taasun kechol asher anachnu osim po hayyom" –
Amar lahen moshe leyisrael: ki ayylitu laaretz yisrael – yesharot takrivu, chovot lo takrivu. menachot unezirot – yesharot ninhu.
Verabbanan – en mincha bevama; nezirot chovot ninhu.
Amar shemuel: machloket bechattat veasham, aval beolot ushelamim – divre hakkol yesharot ninhu, vekarvi.
Motev rabba: chaze vashok uterumat lachme toda – nohagin bevama gedola, veen nohagin bevama ketanna. veillu hazzeroa beshela – shayyeyra;
I amrat bishlama beola ushelamim peligi, ha manni – rabbanan hi. ella i amrat bechattat veasham peligi, ha manni?
Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar – amar shemuel: machloket beola ushelamim, aval bechattat veasham – divre hakkol chovot ninhu, vela karvi.
Amar mar, vachachamim omrim: kol shehatztzibbur makrivin beohel vechulei.
May tamayyhu derabbanan? amar kera: "ish hayyashar beenav yaase"; ish – yesharot hu delikruv, chovot la likruv; vetzibbur – afillu chovot likruv.

a: Verabbi yehuda amar lach: ki ketiv – "hayyashar beenav" hu dichtiv; aval bevama gedola – afillu chovot name likruv.
Ella ha ketiv "ish" – lav lememra deish yesharot hu delikruv, ha chovot la likruv? ki ketiv "ish" – lehacheshir et hazzar.
Zar – mivvezarak hakkohen et haddam al mizbach Adonai" nafka!
Mahu detema live kiddush bechorot kemeikkara; ka mashma lan.
Chachamim hayeynu tanna kamma!
Amar rav pappa: karvu nesachim bemidbar ikka benayyhu.
Amar mar: rabbi shimon omer vechulei. may tameh derabbi shimon? dichtiv: "vayyaasu vene yisrael et happesach baggilgal".
Peshita! ella ha ka mashma lan – dechovot keen pesach hu dekarev, ha lav keen pesach la karev. veiddach –
Mibbee leh lechidrabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi bannaa: arel – mekabbel hazzaa.
Tane tanna kammeh derav adda bar ahava: en ben bama gedola levama ketanna, ella pesach vechovot hakkavua lahen zeman. amar leh: yachid – chovot shekkavua lahen zeman mena leh?
Amar leh: esmeyay? amar leh: tittargam matnitach beolat chova, deikka olat nedava. dei chattat yachid hu – chovot dikvia leh zeman mi ikka?!
Velokma beminchat chova – deha ikka chavittin! ka savar: en mincha bevama.

Bau leshilo vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: katuv echad omer: "vatteviehu bet Adonai shilo", vechatuv echad omer: "vayyittosh (et) mishkan shilo ohel shikken baadam", uchetiv "vayyimas beohel yosef uveshevet efrayim lo vachar".
Ha ketzad? lo hayta sham tikra, ella avanim millemattan viriot millemalan, vehi hayta "menucha".

Kodshe kodashim. mena hane mille? amar rabbi oshaya, deamar kera: "hishshamer lecha pen taale olotecha bechol makom asher (atta) tire" – bechol makom asher tire i atta maale, aval atta ochel bechol makom sheatta roe.
Ema: bechol makom sheatta roe i atta maale, aval atta zoveach bechol makom shettire!
Amar rabbi yannay, amar kera: "sham taale... vesham taase".
Rabbi avdimi bar chassa amar, amar kera:
b: "Velo taanat shilo" – makom shekkol haroe oto mitanneach alav al achilat kadashim shello.
Rabbi avahu amar, amar kera: "ben porat yosef ben porat ale ayin" – ayin shello ratzta lizzon velehanot middavar sheeno shello, tizke vetochal kimlo eneha.
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: "uretzon shochni sene" – ayin shello ratzta lehanot middavar sheeno shello, tizke vetochal ben hassenuin.

Tana: roe sheamru – roe kullo, velo hammafsik beno leveno. amar leh rabbi shimon ben elyakim lerabbi elazar, asbera lach: kegon be chenishta demaon. amar rav pappa: roe sheamru – lo roe kullo, ella roe miktzato.
Bae rav pappa: omed veroe, yoshev veeno roe – may? bae rabbi yirmeya: omed al gabbe hannachal veroe, (yoshev) betoch hannachal veeno roe – may? teku.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi: bishlosha mekomot sharta shechina al yisrael – beshilo, venov vegivon, uvet olamim; uvechullan lo sharta ella bechelek binyamin. shenneemar: "chofef alav kol hayyom" – kol chafifot lo yehu ella bechelko shel binyamin.
Ki azel abbaye, amra kammeh derav yosef. amar: chad bera hava leh lechayylil, vela mittekan. vehachtiv: "vayyittosh et mishkan shilo", uchetiv: "vayyimas beohel yosef uveshevet efrayim lo vachar"!
Amar rav adda: may ka kashya leh? dilma shechina bechelek binyamin, vesanhedri gedola bechelek yosef; middematzinu bevet olamim dishchina bechelko shel binyamin, vesanhedrin bechelek yehuda!

Amar leh: hachi hasheta?! hatam – mikarvan nachalot gabbe hadade; hacha – mi mekarvan?! hacha name mekarvan. kidamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: retzua hayta yotzet mechelko shel yehuda venichneset lechelko shel binyamin, uvah haya mizbeach banuy, vehaya binyamin hatztzaddik mitztaer aleha levolah.
Hacha name – retzua hayta yotzet mechelko shel yosef, lechelko shel binyamin. vehayeynu dichtiv: "taanat shilo".
Ketannae: "chofef alav" – ze mikdash rishon, "kol hayyom" – ze mikdash sheni, "uven ketefav shachen" – ellu yemot hammashiach.
Rabbi omer: "chofef alav" – ze haolam hazze, "kol hayyom" – ellu yemot hammashiach, "uven ketefav shachen" – ze haolam habba.

Tanu rabbanan: yeme ohel moed shebbammidbar – arbaim shana chaser achat. yeme ohel moed shebbaggilgal – arba esre; sheva shekkibbeshu, vesheva shechilleku. yeme ohel moed shebbenov vegivon – chamishshim vasheva. nishtayyeyru leshilo shelosh meot veshivim chaser achat.
Yeme ohel moed shebbammidbar – arbaim chaser achat. menalan? deamar mar: shana rishona – asa moshe et hammishkan, sheniyya – hukam hammishkan veshalach moshe meraggelim.

Shebbaggilgal arba esre – sheva shekkibbeshu vesheva shechilleku. menalan? dekaamar kalev: "ben arbaim shana anochi bishloach moshe eved Adonai oti mikkadesh barnea leraggel et haaretz, vaashev oto davar kaasher im levavi"; uchetiv: "veatta hinne anochi hayyom ben chamesh ushemonim shana".
Ki avreh leyarden bar kamma have – bar shivin vetamne, vekaamar: "ben chamesh ushemonim shana"; hare sheva shekkibbeshu.
Vesheva shechilleku menalan? ibbaet ema: middesheva shekkibbeshu, sheva name shechilleku;
Veibbaet ema: middela mashkachat la bearba esre shana "achar asher hukketa hair".
Ohel moed shebbenov vegivon – chamishshim vasheva. mena lan? dichtiv: "vayhi kehazekiro et aron haelohim";
Vetana: keshemmet eli hakkohen – charva shilo, uvau lenov; keshemmet shemuel haramati – charva nov, uvau legivon.
Uchetiv: "vayhi miyyom shevet haaron bekiryat yearim, vayyirbu hayyamim vayyihyu esrim shana, vayyinnahu kol bet yisrael achare Adonai";
Hane esrim shana – eser shana shemmalach shemuel beatzmo, veshana shemmalach shemuel veshaul, ushetayim shemmalach shaul, vesheva dedavid –

a: Dichtiv: "vehayyamim asher malach david al yisrael – arbaim shana; bechevron malach sheva shanim [vegomer]".
Uvishlomo ketiv: "vayyachel livnoto bishnat arba lemalchuto". nishtayyeyru leshilo shelosh meot veshivim chaser echat.
Bau lenov vegivon [vechulei]. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ki lo batem ad atta el hammenucha veel hannachala";
"El hammenucha" – zo shilo, "nachala" – zo yerushalayim. lamma chillekan? kede litten hetter ben ze laze.
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: maaser sheni name litne! amar leh: maaser – "sham"–"sham" mearon ka yalfi; kevan dearon la hava, maaser name la havay.
I hachi, pesach vekadashim name – desham"–"sham" mearon yalfi; dechevan dearon la hava, inhu name la havo!

Amar leh: daamar lach ha, manni – rabbi shimon hi, deamar: af tzibbur lo hikrivu ella pesach vechovot hakkavua lahen zeman, aval chovot sheen kavua lahem zeman – hacha vehacha la keruv. masar behema – chovot sheen kavua lahen zeman hu, veittakkash masar dagan lemasar behema.

Mikkelal dilrabbi yehuda keruv? in; dehaamar rav adda bar matna: maaser sheni umasar behema neechalin benov vegivon ledivre rabbi yehuda. veha bae bira! velav tane rav yosef: shalosh birot hen – shilo, venov vegivon, uvet olamim? hu tane la vehu amar la: laachilat maaser sheni, veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Bau lirushalayim [vechulei]. tanu rabbanan: "ki lo batem ad atta el hammenucha veel hannachala" – "menucha" zo shilo, "nachala" zo yerushalayim.
Veomer: "hayta li nachalati kearye vayyaar", veomer: "haayit tzavua nachalati li haayit saviv aleha". divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: "menucha" zo yerushalayim, "nachala" zo shilo. veomer: "zot menuchati ade ad po eshev ki ivvitiha", veomer: "ki vachar Adonai betziyyon ivvah lemoshav lo".

Bishlama leman deamar "menucha" zo shilo – hayeynu dichtiv: "el hammenucha veel hannachala". ella leman deamar "menucha" zo yerushalayim, "nachala" zo shilo – "el hannachala veel hammenucha" mibbee leh! hachi kaamar: la mibbaya "menucha" dela metetu, ella afillu lenachala" name la metetu.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: zo vezo shilo. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: zo vezo yerushalayim. bishlama leman deamar "menucha" zo
b: Shilo "nachala" zo yerushalayim, i name ippecha – hayeynu dichtiv: "el hammenucha veel hannachala". ella leman deamar zo vazo shilo, o zo vazo yerushalayim – "menucha nachala" mibbee leh! kashya.
Bishlama leman deamar zo vazo shilo; "menucha" – denachu mikkibbush, "nachala (zo)" – diflagu hatam nachalot, dichtiv: "vaychallek lahem yehoshua vayyappel lahem goral beshilo al pi Adonai".
Ella leman deamar zo vazo yerushalayim; bishlama "nachala" – nachalat olamim. ella "menucha" – may menucha? menuchat aron, dichtiv: "vayhi kenoach haaron".
Bishlama leman deamar zo vazo yerushalayim, aval shilo havo (sharya) [sharyan] bamot – hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyikkach manoach et gedi haizzim veet hammincha vayyaal al hatztzur laAdonai".
Ella leman deamar zo vazo shilo, uvamot havo asiran – may "vayyikkach manoach"? horaat shaa hayta.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael kerabbi shimon ben yochay, deamar: zo vazo yerushalayim. vesimanaych: (mashche) [mashchinhu] gavra legavre.
Kol hakkodashim [vechulei]. amar rav kahana: lo shanu ella bishchita, aval behaalaa – karet name michayyayv.
May tama? deamar kera: "vaalehem tomar" – al hassemuchin tomar.
Matkef la rabba: mi ketiv "vaalehem tomar"?! "alehem" ketiv, vaalehem" karenan!

Veod tanya, arbaa kelalot haya rabbi shimon omer bekadashim: hikdishan bishat issur habbamot, veshachat veheela bishat issur habbamot bachutz – hare hen baase velo taase, veyesh bahen karet. hikdishan bishat hetter habbamot, veshachat veheela bishat issur habbamot – hare hen baase velo taase, veen bahen karet.
Hikdishan bishat issur habbamot, veshachat veheela bachutz bishat hetter habbamot – hare hen baase, veen bahen belo taase.
Hikdishan bishat hetter habbamot, veshachat veheela bishat hetter habbamot – patur mikkelum. teyuveta derav kahana! teyuveta.
Veellu kodashim [vechulei]. semicha – dichtiv: "lifne Adonai vesamach".
Shechitat tzafon – dichtiv: "tzafona lifne Adonai". mattanot saviv – dichtiv: "vezarak al hammizbeach saviv (saviv)".
Tenufa – dichtiv: "vehenif hakkohen lifne Adonai". haggasha – dichtiv: "vehiggishah el hammizbeach".
Rabbi yehuda omer: en mincha bevama. amar rav sheshet: ledivre haomer yesh mincha bevama – yesh ofot bevama. ledivre haomer en mincha bevama – en ofot bevama.
"Zevachim" – velo menachot, "zevachim" – velo ofot.
Vechohen – dichtiv: "vezarak hakkohen". bigde sharet – "lesharet bakkodesh".
Uchele sharet – "asher yeshartu vam bakkodesh". lereach nichoach – dichtiv: "lereach nichoach laAdonai".
Mechitza bedamim – dichtiv: "vehayta hareshet ad chatzi hammizbeach". richutz yadayim – dichtiv: "uvekorvatam el hammizbeach yirchatzu".
Amar rame bar chama: lo shanu ella bekodshe bama ketanna, vehikrivum bevama ketanna; aval bekodshe bama ketanna dekarvinhu bevama gedola – yesh chitztzuy.
Motev rabba: chaze vashok, terumat lachme toda – nohagin bekodshe bama gedola, veen nohagin bekodshe bama ketanna. ema: nohagin bevama gedola, veen nohagin bevama ketanna.
Ikka deamri, amar rame bar chama: lo shanu ella bekodshe bama gedola, vehikrivan bevama gedola; aval bekodshe bama ketanna – af al gav dekarvinhu bevama gedola, en chitztzuy.
Lema mesayyay leh: chaze vashok uterumat lachme toda – nohagin bekodshe bama gedola, veen nohagin bekodshe bama ketanna.
Ema: nohagin bevama gedola, veen nohagin bevama ketanna. ufeliga derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: olat bamat yachid shehichnisah bifnim – kelatuha mechitzot lechol davar.
Bae rabbi zera: olat bamat yachid,

a: Shehichnisah lifnim vehotziah lachutz – mahu? mi amrinan: kevan daayayla – kalta la mechitzta; o dilma, kevan dahadar – hadar?
Lav hayeynu pelugeta derabba verav yosef? ditnan: kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom – moalin bahen, veim alu lo yerdu.
Veibbaya lehu: yardu, mahu sheyyaalu? rabba amar: lo yaalu, verav yosef amar: yaalu.
Tibbee lerabba, tibbee lerav yosef. tibbee lerabba: ad kan la kaamar rabba – ella bemizbeach; dachaze leh mekaddesh, dela chaze la mekaddesh; aval mechitza, af al gav dela chaze lay – kalta.
O dilma, afillu lerav yosef – ad kan la kaamar rav yosef hatam, ella dechad makom hu; aval hacha, ditre mekomot ninhu – la. o dilma la shena? teku.

Milleta difshita leh lerabba bechad gisa, ulerav yosef bechad gisa – mibbee leh lerabbi yannay. devae rabbi yannay: evre olat bamat yachid, shealu lammizbeach veyardu – mahu? hecha delo mashla bahen haur – la tibbee lach; ki tibbee lach – hecha demashla bahen haur. may? teku.
Ittemar: shechitat layla bevamat yachid – rav ushemuel; chad amar: keshera, vechad amar: pesula. veka mippalgi bidrabbi elazar;
Derabbi elazar rame kerae ahadade – ketiv: "vayyomer begadtem gollu elay hayyom even gedola",

Uchetiv: "vayyomer shaul putzu vaam vaamartem lahem haggishu elay ish shoro veish seyehu, ushechattem baze vaachaltem, velo techetu laAdonai leechol al haddam. vayyaggishu chol haam ish shoro veyado hallayla, vayyishchatu sham".
Mar meshanne: kan bechullin, kan bekadashim. umar meshanne: kan bekodshe bama gedola, kan bekodshe bama ketanna.

Ittemar: olat bamat yachid – rav amar: en teuna hefshet venittuach, verabbi yochanan amar: teuna hefshet venittuach. veka mippalgi bidrabbi yose haggelili – detanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: ola shehikrivu yisrael bammidbar – en teuna hefshet venittuach; sheen hefshet venittuach ella meohel moed veelach.
Mar savar: meohel moed veelach – la shena bama gedola, vela shena bama ketanna. umar savar: bevama gedola in, bevama ketanna la.

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan: devarim shebben bama gedola levama ketanna – keren vechevesh visod veribbua bevama gedola, veen keren visod vechevesh veribbua bevama ketanna. kiyyor vechanno bevama gedola, veen kiyyor vechanno bevama ketanna. chaze vashok bevama gedola, veen chaze vashok bevama ketanna.
Devarim sheshshavvta bama gedola levama ketanna: shechita bevama gedola uketanna, hefshet venittuach bigdola uketanna, dam mattir umefaggel bigdola uketanna, mumin uzeman bigdola uketanna.
Aval notar vehazzeman vehattame – shavin baze uvaze.
Tanu rabbanan: minnayin laasot zeman bevama ketanna kevama gedola? amra tora: lan yissaref, ufiggul yissaref; ma piggul – pasul bevama, af lan – pasul bevama.
O kelach lederech zo – deha amra tora: lan yissaref, veyotze yissaref; ma yotze – kasher bevama, af lan – kasher bevama. velav kal vachomer hu meofot:
b: Ma ofot, sheen hammum posel bahen – zeman posel bahen; kodshe bama ketanna, shehammum posel bahen – eno din shezzeman posel bahen?!

Ma leofot – shekken en hazzar kasher bahen; tomar bevama ketanna, shehazzar kasher bah – lo yehe zeman pasul bah?! talmud lomar: "vezot torat zevach hashshelamim" – laasot zeman bama ketanna kizman bama gedola.
Hadaran alach parat chattat, uselika la massechet zevachim
